title: Associate professor in Artificial Intelligence for Medical Applications at SDU Robotics
description:
To support our advancements in deep learning and AI methods for medical image and clinical data analysis SDU Robotics invites applications for one or more associate professor position(s). The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

 

Job descriptionThe successful candidates will contribute to the unit’s current and future research projects and teaching activities. Key responsibilities include, for example to:

  • Be able to collaborate with our experts and colleagues from SDU Robotics in the further development of our core technologies. 

  • Be deeply involved in our regular coordination and joint evolvement of research and project activities. 

  • Raise funding and manage research projects. 

  • Design and conduct lab experiments. 

  • Participate in the practicalities of actual industrial applications. 

  • Organize, plan and conduct excellent teaching for undergraduate and graduate courses. 

  • Independently supervise project courses, and BSc, MSc and PhD thesis projects. 

The position as an associate professor involves primary responsibilities related to research (including the obligation to publish and disseminate scientific knowledge) and research-based teaching (including examination duties) – research and teaching obligations equally. Additionally, the role may encompass knowledge exchange with society, including participation in public debates. Furthermore, it may entail responsibilities such as research management, curriculum development, guidance, supervision, and scholarly assessment. The university determines the specific allocation of tasks, and the emphasis on these tasks may vary over time.

 

Profile and requirementsThe candidates will participate in SDU Robotics' comprehensive research, and the position requires research experience within artificial intelligence and deep learning for medical applications. This includes documented knowledge within some of the following technologies/areas:

  • Deep learning-based classification, segmentation and detection in 2D and 3D medical images.

  • Machine learning methods for analysis of clinical data.

  • Explainable and interpretable AI methods for medical decision support.

The candidates must have a relevant PhD degree (e.g. in computer science, engineering or a related field) and are expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in acquiring and coordinating publicly and/or privately funded projects.

  • Strong track record of directly engaging with clinical or industrial partners in application-oriented projects and/or a relevant international network for research and collaboration activities.

  • Experience with teaching and independently supervising project courses, and BSc and MSc thesis projects.

  • Experience in teaching AI courses for medical image analysis.

Preferably, the candidates have experience with:

  • Medical image analysis

  • Analysis of clinical and healthcare data

  • Explainable AI

  • Experimental design and validation of AI-based systems

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team. 

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have high self-motivation to learn. 

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Have excellent communication skills in English speaking and writing. 

In the assessment of candidates, consideration will be given to: 

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in interdisciplinary research collaboration.

  • Teaching experience.

  • A relevant international network for research and collaboration activities, research experience abroad.

  • Experience in attracting funding for research projects and demonstrated experience in research leadership.

 

Research environment The candidate will be integrated into the unit SDU Robotics, which is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We are a team of currently appr. 60 researchers and engineers specialized in research and development of robot solutions and advanced robot systems within the medical, welfare and industrial domain. 

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. 

The aim of the group is to solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We participate in implementing the results achieved in real solutions with end users like national hospitals, LEGO, Novo Nordisk and Universal Robots.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics.

title: We need 2 rescue zookeeper in rescue zoo
description:
Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

  • One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

  • One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

  • A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

  • Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

  • Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

  • A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

  • Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

  • Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

  • Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

  • Cyber security
  • Privacy engineering
  • Computer Systems
  • Edge/cloud computing
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Data Engineering
  • Big Data Infrastructure
  • Machine Learning Systems

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

  • developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
  • providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
  • participating in grant application activities
  • coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirementsAppointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-trackWhen appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

  • Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
  • A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
  • A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
  • Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.      Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. title: Treasury Analyst, Markets & Analytics
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
Do you want to work in an international investment fund promoting economic and social progress through commercial investments?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor. We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team. The role sits at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analysis, trading and technology. You will support treasury decision-making, execute and analyse financial transactions, develop and use the tools and data infrastructure used by the Treasury function.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Negotiate, execute and support FX, money-market, interest-rate and derivative transactions, including swaps and hedging activities.

  • Perform quantitative analysis of FX, interest-rate and liquidity risk via statistics and scenario analyses.

  • Develop models for cash-flow forecasting, liquidity management, pricing and risk/position management.

  • Develop and maintain Treasury analytics and reporting using SQL, Python, Power BI and/or Excel/VBA.

  • Extract, structure and analyse data from Treasury Risk/Position Systems, Investment Management Systems, ERP systems and market-data platforms.

  • Automate Treasury processes and controls and contribute to improvements in the Treasury IT architecture.

  • Support and pursue implementation and valuation of new financial products.

  • Monitor financial markets and provide analysis supporting funding, investment and hedging decisions.

 

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar.

  • Initial relevant work experience, for example 1–3 years' experience from a student job or up to 2 years full-time experience after graduation within Treasury, trading, financial markets and quantitative finance.

  • Practical experience with FX, interest rates, derivatives and/or money-market instruments.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience with SQL and ideally Python, VBA or similar programming languages.

  • Understanding of databases, APIs, data structures and financial systems.

  • Experience with Treasury Management Systems, ERP systems, Investment Management Systems and market-data platforms is an advantage. Especially Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Microsoft Dynamics platform/data structure and Bloomberg.

  • Ability to translate complex financial requirements into robust analytical and IT solutions.

  • Proficiency in English is required, while spoken Danish is an advantage.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a service-minded approach to collaborating with colleagues and counterparties across countries and cultures. Experience working in an international organisation is considered an advantage.

 

We offer you employment in a unique organisation, where you will get experience working in an international business environment. The position is based in our headquarter Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 18 November. We conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of cleanand sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dkHow to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (4-5 pages), that: describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and ScienceSalary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:
At Gram Equipment, we develop the technology behind ice cream products enjoyed by people around the world.

As a global provider of equipment and complete production solutions for the ice cream industry, we combine more than a century of experience with innovation, technical expertise and close customer collaboration. Our filling solutions help customers produce cups, cones, tubs and other filled products efficiently, reliably and at high quality.

We are now looking for a Product Owner to help develop and strengthen our filling product portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.

Your Role

As Product Owner – Flexline, you will take technical ownership of our filling product portfolio and play a central role in its continued development.

You will connect customer requirements, market opportunities and operational experience with engineering and product development. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Automation, Sales, Projects, Production and Service, you will ensure that our filling solutions remain competitive, reliable and aligned with customer needs.

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

The role does not include direct personnel responsibility. Your influence comes through your product expertise, judgment and ability to create alignment across functions.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Roadmap
  • Maintain and develop the roadmap for Gram Equipment’s filling product portfolio.
  • Identify and prioritize product improvements based on customer needs, field experience, market developments and business priorities.
  • Define product requirements and help translate strategic priorities into concrete development activities.
  • Monitor competitor technologies and identify relevant performance or technology gaps.
  • Maintain product standards and ensure that approved improvements are implemented and sustained.
Technical and Cross-Functional Execution
  • Support project reviews, design approvals, technical clarifications and decisions concerning product interfaces.
  • Ensure that project-specific solutions remain aligned with product standards, technical feasibility, safety, cost and delivery requirements.
  • Coordinate closely with mechanical engineering, automation, production, assembly and project management.
  • Support testing, validation and commissioning and use the resulting learning to improve the product portfolio.
  • Contribute to the resolution of complex technical and field-performance issues.
Commercial and Customer Support
  • Support Sales and Internal Sales with quotations, equipment selection, configurations and technical customer dialogue.
  • Participate in customer meetings and communicate product capabilities, options and technical limitations clearly.
  • Balance filling performance, customer value, reliability, standardization and commercial competitiveness.
  • Develop an understanding of customer applications and production requirements and use this insight to strengthen future solutions.
Product Lifecycle Management
  • Maintain relevant product specifications, documentation, equipment structures and product data.
  • Coordinate product changes and ensure that decisions are properly documented, released and communicated.
  • Support standardization and lifecycle management across existing and future filling platforms.
  • Ensure that products comply with relevant food-safety, hygienic-design, machine-safety and regulatory requirements.
Your Profile

We are looking for someone who combines strong technical understanding with product ownership, commercial awareness and an interest in working across the organization.

You bring:

  • A relevant technical education, preferably within mechanical engineering, process technology, production engineering or a comparable field.
  • Experience with product ownership, product development, mechanical engineering or technical project execution within industrial machinery or a related industry.
  • A good understanding of mechanical equipment, machine interfaces and the interaction between mechanics and automation.
  • Experience with hygienic equipment, food production or filling and dosing technology is an advantage.
  • The ability to understand customer applications and translate technical and commercial needs into product requirements and practical solutions.
  • A structured approach to product roadmaps, technical decisions, documentation and follow-up.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of how product decisions influence customer value, project performance and lifecycle cost.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills and the ability to influence decisions without formal authority.
  • Good written and spoken English.

Experience with Inventor, Vault, AutoCAD, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central or comparable engineering and ERP systems would be an advantage.

Above all, you are curious about how products perform in real customer environments. You enjoy developing technical knowledge, asking questions and bringing people together around solutions that work across the full value chain.

What We Offer
  • A central role with genuine influence on the future direction of Gram Equipment’s filling portfolio with emphasis on the Flexline product.
  • The opportunity to combine technology, customer insight, commercial understanding and product development.
  • Close cooperation with experienced specialists across Engineering, Automation, Sales, Production, Projects and Service.
  • An international working environment with customers and colleagues across global markets.
  • Opportunities for professional development and increasing product responsibility.
  • An informal and collaborative workplace where knowledge sharing and practical improvement are valued.
  • Competitive employment conditions aligned with your experience and qualifications.

The position is based at our headquarters in Kolding, Denmark. You should expect approximately 0–30 travel days per year, primarily for customer meetings, technical clarification, commissioning support and product validation.

Apply Now

Would you like to take ownership of filling technology and help turn customer needs, market insight and engineering expertise into competitive product solutions?

Join Gram Equipment and help shape the next generation of industrial ice cream filling equipment.

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)
description: **Type:** Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki, Copenhagen, Stockholm**Application deadline:** Tue 1.12.2026Join Teamspective, a fast-growing Finnish AI-native SaaS company transforming how organizations lead their people. We're hiring two Account Executives to drive our expansion into Denmark and Sweden!**Your role with us**Teamspective is on a mission to make great leadership a competitive advantage. Our AI-native platform turns employee insights into practical guidance for leaders routines, helping managers lead better every day. With strong growth, proven customer success across the Nordics, and ambitious international plans, we're now ready to accelerate our expansion into Denmark and Sweden.As our **Account Executive for Denmark**, you'll build on our existing customer relationships and strong references, including **Danfoss**, to expand Teamspective's presence in the Danish market. As our **Account Executive for Sweden**, youll focus on opening new opportunities and growing our customer base in a market where were already working with companies like **Hitta.se**. In either role, you'll take ownership of your market and help shape how Teamspective grows internationally.**Your key responsibilities will include:**- Owning the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline building to closing deals, with a focus on mid-sized and large organizations. - Leading discovery meetings and product demos to uncover customer needs and demonstrate Teamspective's value. - Driving B2B sales processes from initial contact to negotiations, procurement, and closing. - Building trusted relationships with HR leaders and other decision-makers through consultative selling. - Developing your market approach and identifying opportunities to scale Teamspective's presence in your country. You'll work closely with our CRO and CEO, existing sales team, and colleagues in customer success and product development, giving you direct access to commercial leadership and the expertise behind our product.Looking further ahead, as Teamspective's presence in your market grows, you could have the opportunity to step into a Country Manager role and build and lead your own local sales team.**Who we're looking for**You're a commercially driven, hands-on sales professional who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and turning opportunities into results. You know how to engage HR decision-makers and understand what drives their business. You bring strong Danish or Swedish language skills and an understanding of your respective market. Above all, you thrive on taking ownership and are excited to build and grow a market over the long term.**What we expect from you:**- At least 3 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably SaaS, technology, or HR-related - Experience in solution sales to a clearly defined B2B customer segment, with the ability to understand customer challenges and demonstrate business value - A proven track record in new business acquisition and managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing deals - A proactive, independent approach to sales and the drive to build your own pipeline and develop a market - Excellent Danish skills for the Denmark position, or excellent Swedish skills for the Sweden position, alongside good English skills **What we consider a plus:**- Experience selling HR technology solutions or other B2B solutions to HR decision-makers, with an understanding of their business challenges - An established network of HR leaders and decision-makers in Denmark or Sweden - Previous experience opening new markets or developing sales operations in an international growth company **What we offer you:**- Build your market and shape the go-to-market strategy with real ownership. - Sell an AI-native solution that helps organizations turn better leadership into a competitive advantage. - Work alongside experienced leaders and a tight-knit team that moves fast and has your back. - Drive international growth with a proven product, strong customer references, and room to make your mark. - Grow toward a potential Country Manager role and eventually build and lead your own local team. **Practicalities:**These are full-time, permanent positions in which you will be employed directly by Teamspective. You can be based in Helsinki or your respective target market, Copenhagen or Stockholm, after the initial onboarding period. The preferred starting date is as soon as possible in early 2027.**Onboarding:**The role requires you to spend your first 3–6 months working in Helsinki. During this period, you will work closely with Teamspective's commercial, customer success, and product teams, build a deep understanding of the product, and start developing your market from day one. Teamspective will cover accommodation in Helsinki for candidates relocating temporarily. After onboarding, you can work from Helsinki or your respective target country, with regular visits to Helsinki.**Compensation:**The base salary in this position starts from 4000 €/month, complemented by an uncapped commission. As an indicative estimate, on-target earnings (OTE) could range from 90-110 000 euros annually, depending on sales performance. The commission model also includes incentives for qualified meetings during the probationary period. You'll also join Teamspective's employee stock option program after your probationary period. As you grow into a Sales Manager or Country Manager role, there may be opportunities to negotiate a larger equity stake.**Ready to build success in a new market?**Please submit your CV and brief motivation statement by the latest Tue 1st of December 2026 via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/396854/create/.Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

title: Kinnisvarahaldur
description:
Tööülesanded: El Castillo OÜ arendab ja haldab üürikinnisvara Tallinnas. Otsime inimest, kes aitaks hoida meie üürimajad korras ning korraldada igapäevast suhtlust üürnike ja hoolduspartneritega. Sa ei pea olema kogenud kinnisvarahaldur. Ootame kandideerima ka õppijaid ja valdkonda sisenejaid. Olulised on vastutustunne, hea suhtlemisoskus ja soov õppida. Meie protsesse ja süsteeme tutvustame ning aitame sul tegevustesse sisse elada. Millega hakkad tegelema? -Suhtled üürnikega, vastad nende pöördumistele ja korraldad küsimuste lahendamist. -Aitad korraldada üürilepingute sõlmimist ning korterite üleandmist ja vastuvõtmist. -Külastad regulaarselt hooneid ja kortereid ning märkad hooldus- ja remondivajadusi. -Tellid hooldus- ja remonditöid olemasolevatelt koostööpartneritelt ning jälgid nende tegemist. -Koordineerid suhtlust kommunaalteenuste pakkujate ja tehnosüsteemide hooldajatega. -Kontrollid kuluarveid, hoiad info ja dokumendid korras ning koostad omanikule lihtsaid ülevaateid.

Omalt poolt pakume: -Vastastikuse sobivuse ja objektide vajaduse korral võimalust kasvatada töömahtu kuni 80 tunnini kuus ning töötasu kuni 1200 euroni kuus.-Paindlikku ajakorraldust: planeerid oma tegevused ise, arvestades objektide vajaduste ja kokkulepitud tähtaegadega. -Juhendamist ning praktilisi kogemusi kinnisvara- ja üürihalduses. -Võimalust siduda tegevus erialase praktikaga, kooskõlastades selle õppeasutusega. -Võimalust kasvada koos areneva üürikinnisvaraettevõttega.

title: Finance Development Specialist
description: Do you want to join us in building a cleaner tomorrow? Gasum is a Nordic energy expert. Our purpose is to help our customers navigate the energy transition by offering cleaner energy and superior energy management services.We are looking for a Finance Development Specialist based in our Espoo office.Our purpose is to secure access to cleaner energy for our customers. We help them navigate the energy transition towards continuously reducing emissions. Our areas of expertise are biogas, liquefied biogas (LBG), natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) and electricity markets. We own and operate biogas plants and an extensive network of gas filling stations in the Nordic countries. Our customers include industry and businesses that use a lot of energy as well as maritime and land transport providers.As Finance Development Specialist, you will join our Finance Development team that leads and coordinates finance-related development initiatives across the Group Finance organization, including AR, AP, Reporting, Treasury &amp; Back Office functions.Finance Development Specialist is responsible for developing and maintaining finance systems, reporting logic, master data, and for ensuring that processes and controls effectively support finance operations and business requirements. The role identifies, develops and promotes appropriate automation and AI-enabled solutions to improve process efficiency, data quality, control reliability and the use of Finance information. The position reports to Manager, Finance Development and Centralized services.The person acts as the primary finance representative for ERP and Finance system development, working closely with IT, external service providers, and finance stakeholders to ensure systems are efficient, reliable, and aligned with finance and business needs.Main responsibilities in the role are: - Finance systems ownership &amp; master data maintenance - ERP development &amp; continuous Improvement - Business partnering with IT - Testing &amp; release management - User support &amp; training - Process and control documentationWhat we expect from you: - Masters degree in accounting, finance, business administration or information systems, or Bachelor's degree supplemented by strong relevant experience - 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in finance, financial systems, ERP development, accounting-process development or a comparable role - Preferred experience with D365FO - Good understanding of end-to-end finance processes and internal controls - Fluent professional English and Finnish; proficiency in Swedish is considered an advantageWhat we offer you: - Interesting tasks in a Nordic work environment and a front row seat into the renewable energy transition - A positive and encouraging work community that drives change together - Development opportunities in our sustainable, innovative and inclusive company - A forward looking and modern workplace and an encouraging team to support you - Flexibility in terms of working remotely or at the office in accordance with job requirements - Various employment benefits and events, please read more here: Gasum as an employer | GasumAt Gasum, we live by our values Respect, Sustainability and Positive energy. Our ethical code covers looking after people and the environment alike. Our purpose is to help our customers get access to cleaner energy and energy market services.We look forward to your application! Please apply latest by 7.12.2026, enclosing your CV and cover letter. For inquiries about the vacancy, please contact Anni Suvinen, Manager, Finance Development and Centralized Services, 26th November at 9-10 EET or 16-17 EET, on +358405644302.Gasum values equality and diversity within the work community. We welcome applicants from different backgrounds, such as people of different ages, genders, and those belonging to different language, cultural, or minority groups. Learn more about our company.Gasum is a Nordic gas sector and energy market expert. Our areas of expertise are biogas, liquefied biogas (LBG), natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG) and electricity markets. We own and operate biogas plants and an extensive network of gas filling stations in the Nordic countries. Our customers include industry and businesses that use a lot of energy as well as maritime and land transport providers.

title: Liikunnanohjaaja Liikkuva Kortteli-hankkeeseen
employer: Vantaan Nuorten Miesten Kristillinen Yhdistys ry
description: NMKY – YMCA on maailman suurin nuorisojärjestö, joka toimii yli 120 maassa. YMCA Vantaa – Vantaan NMKY ry kuuluu YMCA liikkeeseen. Keskeisimpiä toimintamuotojamme ovat nuoriso-, nuorisotila-, iltapäivä- ja harrastustoiminta sekä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden leirit.Haemme kaksivuotiseen Suomi Liikkeelle-ohjelman Liikkuva kortteli-toimintaan hanketyöntekijää, joka vastaa hankkeen käytännön toteutuksesta, arvioinnista, seurannasta ja raportoinnista. Haemme hankkeeseen työntekijää, jolla on liikunta-alan koulutus (esim. liikuntaneuvoja) sekä taito huolehtia, että kokonaisuus etenee hankkeen tavoitteiden ja aikataulun mukaisesti. Hankkeessa työskentelee YMCAn projektitiimi ja tukenasi on hankkeesta YMCA Vantaalla vastaava nuorisotoiminnan koordinaattori.Liikkuva kortteli -toiminnan tavoitteena on lisätä erityisesti lasten ja nuorten liikkumista arjessa ja vähentää liikkumisen eriarvoistumista. Maksutonta liikunnallista toimintaa järjestetään taloyhtiön pihoilla, puistoissa ja lähiluonnossa. Liikkuva kortteli-toimintaa kehitetään tiiviissä yhteistyössä eri toimijoiden kanssa, joten aiempi kokemus verkosto- ja yhteistyöstä on edellytys työssä onnistumisessa. Toiminta keskittyy valtakunnallisesti kaupunginosiin, joissa asukkailla on keskimäärin haastavampi sosioekonominen asema ja kohonnut riski vähäiselle liikunnan harrastamiselle. Vantaalla toiminta-alueena hankkeen alkaessa on Itä- ja Länsi-Vantaan alueet. Hankkeen alussa työaika määräytyy noin 50% ohjaustyöstä ja 50% muusta hallinnollisesta hanketyöstä (mm. suunnittelu, organisointi, viestintä, kehittämistyö, seuranta, verkosto- ja yhteistyö).**Tehtäviisi kuuluu mm.**- liikunta- ja vapaa-ajantoiminnan sekä tapahtumien suunnittelu, toteutus ja arviointi - osallisuuden, hyvinvoinnin ja yhteisöllisyyden edistäminen - hallinnollinen hanketyö - verkosto- ja yhteistyö mm. VAV:in ja asukasyhdistysten kanssa sekä järjestöjen ja muiden yhteistyökumppaneidemme kanssa **Odotamme sinulta**- soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. liikuntaneuvoja) ja/tai vahva liikunnallinen tausta ja osaaminen - hyvää organisointi- ja kokonaisuudenhallintakykyä sekä itsenäistä, suunnitelmallista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta · positiivista ja innostavaa asennetta sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja ryhmänohjaustaitoja· oma-aloitteisuutta ja kykyä toimia sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä· kiinnostusta liikunnan, hyvinvoinnin ja osallisuuden edistämiseen- kokemus kokonaisuuksien organisoinnista sekä kehittämis-, suunnittelu- ja arviointityöstä luetaan eduksi - autonkäyttömahdollisuus luetaan eduksi, sillä työ on liikkuvaa **Tarjoamme**- merkityksellisen työn liikunnan parissa - mukavan ja osaavan työyhteisön tuen - mahdollisuuden kehittää toimintaa, hyödyntää omia vahvuuksia sekä kehittää omaa osaamista - monipuoliset työtehtävät sekä vaihtelevan työympäristön Työ on osa-aikainen, 70-80%, sopimuksen mukaan. Huomioithan, että ohjaustyötä tehdään niin aamu- kuin ilta-aikoina ja työ sisältää myös satunnaista viikonlopputyötä. Viikkotyöaika on mahdollista räätälöidä työntekijän toiveiden mukaisesti neljä tai viisi päiväiseksi. Työsuhde on määräaikainen hankkeen kestosta johtuen.Työ alkaa 25.1.2027. Työsopimus tehdään aluksi ensimmäiseksi hankevuodeksi, 31.12.2027 asti, jonka jälkeen työsuhdetta on mahdollista jatkaa seuraavalle hankevuodelle.Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa: Nuorisotoiminnan koordinaattori Hanna Sares (044-902 2998) tai Järjestöpäällikkö Marika Ahola (050-551 0447)Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi viimeistään 13.12.2026 osoitteeseen: vantaa@ymca.fi Työntekijä palkataan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. title: Työpäällikkö, Uudenmaan kunnossapitourakat
description: Etsimme työpäällikköä Uudenmaan alueelle. Tässä roolissa vastaat alueesi infran toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja elinkaaren hallinnasta sekä johdat urakoita suunnitelmallisesti ja tavoitteellisesti.Minkälaiseen rooliin ja tiimiin olisit tulossa?Työpäällikkönä johdat urakoiden kokonaisuuksia suunnittelusta toteutukseen sekä varmistat, että työ sujuu aikataulussa, budjetissa ja laatuvaatimusten mukaisesti. Toimit esihenkilönä oman alueesi henkilöstölle ja osallistut aktiivisesti myyntityöhön ja asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen.Työsuhde on vakituinen ja alkaa viimeistään 1.1.2027. Työsopimuspaikka on Helsinki, Vantaa tai sopimuksen mukaan.Tehtäväsi keskeiset vastuualueet tiivistetysti:- Urakoiden suunnittelu, toteutuksen johtaminen ja raportointi- Aikataulujen, budjetin, laadun ja turvallisuuden seuranta ja hallinta- Kassavirran ja laajuusvaatimusten varmistaminen- Resurssi- ja osaamistarpeiden määrittely urakoihin- Esihenkilön tehtävät rekrytoinnista työsuhteen päättymiseen- Asiakkuuksien hoito ja myyntityö: tunnistaminen, tarjouslaskenta ja sopimusten solmiminen- Viestintä ja yhteydenpito sisäisiin ja ulkoisiin sidosryhmiinMiten onnistut parhaiten tehtävässä?Meillä menestyminen rakentuu arvojen mukaiselle toiminnalle: rehdisti, yhdessä, uudistuen ja menestyen. Arkemme valinnat vaikuttavat suoraan siihen, miten ihmiset liikkuvat, elävät ja viihtyvät ympäristössään, siksipä teknisen osaamisen lisäksi tarvitsemme myös kykyä nähdä infran inhimillinen merkitys.Tehtävässä onnistuaksesi tarvitset:- Soveltuvan teknisen koulutuksen- Vähintään viiden vuoden kokemuksen vastaavista tehtävistä- Kokemusta kunnossapidosta, rakentamisesta ja projektinhallinnasta- Suunnitelmallisuutta ja tulosorientoitunutta toimintatapaa- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoaLisäksi arvostamme vahvoja vuorovaikutus-, neuvottelu- ja yhteistyötaitoja. Olet verkostoituva ja tavoitteellinen ammattilainen, joka ymmärtää infran rakentamisen ja kunnossapidon kokonaisuudet ja niiden vaikutuksen ihmisten arkeen.Lupaamme, että DestiallaDestialla pääset tekemään työtä, jolla on merkitys ihmisten arjessa. Rakennamme ja ylläpidämme infraa sen koko elinkaaren ajan yhdessä eri alojen osaajien kanssa tiimeissä, joissa jokaisen työpanos on tärkeä. Meillä voit kehittää osaamistasi ja rakentaa urapolkuasi omaan suuntaasi myös kansainvälisesti osana Colas-konsernia. Kehitämme jatkuvasti mittauspuolen tekemistämme ja käytössämme on monipuolisesti eri teknologiaa. Kollegasi ovat kokeneita alan ammattilaisia, jotka sparraavat mielellään.Haluamme, että Destialle on helppo hakea erilaisista taustoista käsin. Kohtelemme toisiamme yhdenvertaisesti ja arvostavasti, ja uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät, kun ihmiset saavat olla työssään omia itsejään ja tuoda esiin erilaisia näkökulmia. Kannamme vastuuta ihmisistä, ympäristöstä ja yhteiskunnasta arjen teoissa. Vastuullisuus näkyy meillä siinä, miten teemme töitä, huolehdimme toisistamme ja kehitämme infraa, joka palvelee ihmisiä pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Meille tärkeintä on, että nämä lupaukset näkyvät myös destialaisten omissa kokemuksissa joka päivä. [Lue lisää vastuullisuudesta ja tavastamme toimia nettisivuiltamme](https://destia.fi/tietoa-meista/vastuullisuus/).Kiinnostuksesi herättyä toimi näinHae meille työkaveriksi työpaikkailmoituksen kohdasta "Hae tähän työpaikkaan", ja kerro vapaamuotoisesti osaamisestasi ja toiveistasi CV:n ja hakemuskirjeen muodossa. Seuraathan sähköpostiasi, sillä saat meiltä viestejä haun etenemisestä säännöllisesti. Haastattelut aloitamme usein jo hakuajalla sopivien ehdokkaiden kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja Destialla työskentelystä antaa työpäällikkö Eero Mikkola, 0400 607 267 tai eero.mikkola@destia.fi.HenkilöstöedutTyön vastapainoksi, työssä viihtymiseksi ja kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukemiseksi Destia tarjoaa työntekijöilleen mm. seuraavia etuja:- ePassi: hammaslääkäri-, hieronta-, liikunta-, työmatka-, lounas- ja kulttuurietu (400e/v.)- Lounasetu ei sisälly 400 euroon, vaan on oma etunsa. Henkilöstö on joko lounaspassin tai ateriakorvauksen piirissä.- työterveyshuollon laaja palvelutarjonta- lomaosaketarjonta- henkilöstörahastoHenkilöstöedut-listaus koskee yleisesti Destialla työskenteleviä. Eduissa saattaa olla hieman vaihtelevuutta työsuhteen luonteen ja keston mukaan.Destia OyDestia on suurin infra-alan palveluita Suomessa tuottava yhtiö ja osa kansainvälistä Colas-konsernia. Luomme hyvän yhteiskunnan perustaa suunnittelemalla, rakentamalla ja ylläpitämällä huomisen liikenne- ja energiainfraa. Teemme sen noin 1 900 destialaisen ainutlaatuisella infran tajulla. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli noin 790 miljoonaa euroa. [www.destia.fi](http://www.destia.fi/)Sähköposti: eero.mikkola@destia.fi Sijainti: Uusimaa

title: Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan
description:
Ajoneuvoasentaja Vaasaan!

Haemme asiakkaallemme ajoneuvoasentajaa kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Vaasaan.

Nopeasta reagointikyvystään ja laadukkaasta kiinteistöpalvelustaan tunnettu yritys etsii nyt tiimin vahvistukseksi kokenutta ja ammattitaitoista ajoneuvoasentajaa.

Työtehtävät:

Asentajana vastaat yrityksen oman kaluston kuten pakettiautojen, pyöräkuormaajien ja muiden koneiden kunnossapidosta, huolloista, vianhausta ja korjaustöistä. Työ pitää sisällään monipuolisesti korjauksia, varusteluja, perushuoltoja sekä päivittäisen kaluston toimintakuntoon liittyviä tehtäviä yrityksen omalla korjaamolla. Toimit itsenäisesti ja varmistat omalla panoksellasi, että kentällä tarvittavat koneet ja autot pysyvät liikkeellä ilman turhia katkoksia.

 * Käytännön kokemusta autojen ja työkoneiden huolto- ja korjaustöistä.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

 * Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työpaikan vakavaraisella ja arvostetulla paikallisella toimijalla.
 * Vaihtelevan ja itsenäisen työnkuvan, jossa näet kättesi jäljen välittömästi.
