title: Postdoc (f_m_x) – Hydraulic Stimulation for Enhanced Geothermal Systems (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
description: The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences is one of the world's leading institutions in the field of geosciences. As part of the Helmholtz Association, Germany's largest research organisation, we address global challenges such as natural hazards, climate change and the sustainable use of resources. In doing so, we combine cutting-edge research with social relevance. Our international staff - around 1,200 employees and approx. 500 guests - work in a multidisciplinary way and with a unique infrastructure to research the dynamic processes of the Earth system. Our vision: "Taking the pulse of our Earth to safeguard a habitable planet."For the EU-funded project UPLIFT in section4.3 Geoenergy (https://www.gfz.de/en/section/geoenergy/overview) (department 'Geosystems (https://www.gfz.de/en/departments/geosystems) '), we are looking for a:Research scientist (f_m_x) – Geothermal Reservoir StimulationReference Number 11660UPLIFT (https://uplift-horizon.eu/) brings together key European Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS (https://www.geothermie.de/bibliothek/lexikon-der-geothermie/e/egs) ) industry and research institutions to demonstrate, at Czechia's leading energy research site RINGEN, how water-only multi-stage hydraulic shear stimulation treatments can be efficiently implemented in metamorphic basement rocks in Europe, while reducing technical, social, and environmental risks.A central focus is the development and application of adaptive stimulation designs that use real-time seismic and hydraulic data to improve treatment efficiency and safety. The project will also investigate micro-turbine drilling as an alternative to conventional perforation techniques to improve reservoir access. Laboratory experiments will assess the self-propping behaviour of European basement rocks and benchmark their stimulation response against acid- and proppant-based methods. Water-only and proppant-based stimulation treatments will also be compared at the Bedretto Underground Laboratory. In parallel, the project will develop high-fidelity, physics-based digital twins to guide stimulation design, alongside fast surrogate models to support real-time operational decision-making. The stimulation activities are supported by high-resolution, real-time seismic monitoring, conventional and adaptive traffic light systems, and social science research.As a postdoctoral researcher, you will play a central role in planning, supervising and analysing the adaptive multi-stage hydraulic stimulation treatments at the RINGEN EGS site in Litoměřice, Czechia. This position offers the opportunity to connect advanced research with field operations and contribute directly to developing efficient, safe geothermal stimulation technologies.Your responsibilities:- Co-lead the hydraulic stimulation and well test activities at the Litoměřice EGS site- Analyse stimulation and well test data to compare and understand the hydraulic and seismic response of metamorphic basement rock to different stimulation methods and injection protocols, including adaptive injection strategies- Contribute to detailed operational planning and the preparation of tender documents- Contribute to the techno-economic assessment of different stimulation methods and their implications for EGS development- Publish your findings in peer-reviewed journals and communicate them at scientific conferences and to non-scientific stakeholdersAbout You:Essential Qualifications:- A Master's degree (or equivalent) and a PhD (or equivalent industry experience) in reservoir/petroleum engineering, drilling/completion engineering, geophysics, geothermal energy, applied geosciences, or equivalent- Research or industry background in Enhanced Geothermal Systems, well stimulation or induced seismicity- Well test analysis- Proficiency in spoken and written EnglishDesirable Qualifications:- German or Czech language skills are useful, but not required- Strong motivation and creativity, combined with an independent, structured, reliable and results-oriented working attitude- Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with interdisciplinary project partners, the scientific community, engineers, and non-technical stakeholdersStart date: 1st February 2027Fixed-term: 36 MonateSalary: Die Stelle ist nach TVöD Bund mit der Entgeltgruppe 13 bewertet. Die Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den tariflichen Bestimmungen und den entsprechenden persönlichen Voraussetzungen.Working hours: Vollzeit (derzeit 39 h/Woche); die Stelle ist grundsätzlich teilzeitgeeignet.Place of work: PotsdamWhat we offer:- Ambitious and varied tasks in a dynamic and international research environment- State-of-the-art equipment- Public service benefits- Extensive training opportunities- Professional career advice offered by our in-house Career-Centre- Flexible working hours and conditions- Support with finding a good work-life balance offered by benefit@work- Institute day-care centre on site- Working at the Albert Einstein Science Park on the Telegrafenberg in Potsdam- Workplace within walking distance of Potsdam main train station, or just a short ride on the shuttle busHave we piqued your interest?If so, we look forward to receiving your application by 13th December 2026. Please use our online application form only.Required documents: letter of motivation, CV, grades/certificatesThe GFZ actively promotes diversity and equal opportunities. title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d) (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description: Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.Why join us?- Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.- Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.- International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.- Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.- Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.About us – in briefHeadquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.Your Role – What You'll OwnYou will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.Your Responsibilities- Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.- Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.- Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.- Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.- Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.- Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.- Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.- Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.What You BringWe are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.Must-have – Essential RequirementsThe following skills and experience are essential for this position:Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure- Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.- Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.- Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.Infrastructure Modernization- A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.- Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.- Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.Identity & Access Management- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.- Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.- Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.Endpoint Management- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.Resilience, Security & Monitoring- Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.- Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.Communication & Collaboration- Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.- Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.- Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.- Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.Nice-to-have – Additional ExperienceThe following skills are beneficial but not essential:- Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.- Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.- Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.- Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.- Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.- Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.- Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.- Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.- Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.Your First 12 MonthsYour initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:- Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.- Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.- Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.- Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.- Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.- Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.- Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.What We Offer- Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.- Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.- Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.- Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.- Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.- Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.- Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)Start date: As soon as possible⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-timeReady to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Spezialist Wertpapierabwicklung (m/w/d) – Sparpläne und Altersvorsorgedepot  (Wertpapiersachbearbeiter/in)
description: Einzigartiger Service braucht ein großartiges TeamDie Deutsche WertpapierService Bank AG ist mit über 22 Jahren Erfahrung im Wertpapiergeschäft der führende Dienstleister für Wertpapierservices in Deutschland. Mit unserer Systemplattform WP3 verarbeiten wir für über 1.000 Banken jedes Jahr mehrere Millionen Wertpapiertransaktionen – schnell, stabil und sicher. An unseren Standorten in Eschborn, Düsseldorf und München arbeiten über 1.200 Mitarbeitende tagtäglich daran, dass unsere Kundeninstitute am Finanzplatz Deutschland erfolgreicher sind. Unser Anspruch: Erste Wahl für Wertpapierservices zu sein. Lass uns diese spannende Herausforderung gemeinsam angehen!Dein Team und deine Aufgaben - das erwartet dich:Unser Team aus sieben Kolleg:innen betreut die Produktfamilie WPSparen im Wertpapiergeschäft. Mit dem Start des neuen Altersvorsorgedepots (AVD) bauen wir das Team aus und suchen Verstärkung.Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem AVD sowie der gesamten WPSparen Produktfamilie. Mit dem Produktstart und steigendem Auftragsvolumen wechseln wir vom Projektteam in die Linie und arbeiten zukünftig als agiles Team in der Subdomäne WPSparen zusammen.Vieles ist noch im Aufbau, und nicht jeder Prozess steht schon fest. Entsprechend kannst du Produkt und Arbeitsweise von Anfang an mitgestalten und dich als Spezialist Wertpapierabwicklung (m/w/d) u.a. auf folgende Aufgaben freuen:- Produkte der WPSparen-Familie betreuen:  Sparpläne, Wiederanlagemanagement und VL-Sparen: Die Produktfamilie WPSparen liegt in deiner Hand. Du sorgst dafür, dass Sparpläne in Fonds, ETFs, Zertifikaten und Aktien korrekt ausgeführt und abgerechnet werden. Bei Auffälligkeiten analysierst du die Ursache, behebst sie und informierst die Kunden. Neue regulatorische Anforderungen hast du dabei immer im Blick.- **Prozesse neu denken: ** Ein neues Produkt braucht schlanke Prozesse, und die entwickelst du mit. Du bringst dein Fachwissen in die Gestaltung des AVD ein, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und machst Abläufe, die heute noch manuell laufen, fit für die Automatisierung. Außerdem begleitest du fachliche Weiterentwicklungen und testest Neuerungen im System.- **Kunden im Altersvorsorgedepot begleiten: ** Beim Einstieg ins AVD stehst du unseren Kunden zur Seite. Vom Onboarding bis zur Beantwortung von Rückfragen und Tickets sorgst du dafür, dass sie schnell und sicher im Produkt ankommen.- **Gattungen und Datenlieferungen pflegen: ** Ein aktuelles Produktuniversum ist die Grundlage unseres Angebots. title: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d)  in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring (Biologe/Biologin)
description: Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic MonitoringSenckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of Genomic Biomonitoring at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01.02.2027:**Postdoctoral Researcher (f/m/d) in Conservation Genetics and Genetic Monitoring ****(Full-Time / Part-Time)**Location: FrankfurtEmployment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.Genetic diversity is a fundamental component of biodiversity, providing the evolutionary potential that allows species and populations to adapt to environmental change. Yet genetic diversity is declining and remains comparatively underrepresented in biodiversity monitoring and policy. At the Genomic Biomonitoring Lab at Senckenberg, we work to address that gap and are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join us in that aim.The position will focus on how genetic diversity can be measured, monitored and incorporated into practical conservation. This spans from species-level applications to national and international biodiversity policy. The researcher will contribute to ongoing projects on endangered and threatened species where genomics is needed to support management or can be used for monitoring. At the international scale, there is scope to investigate how genetic diversity can be incorporated into global biodiversity frameworks and assessments.We are looking for a researcher who is excited to help shape this emerging research area. The postdoctoral researcher will have the opportunity to develop new research questions and projects under our shared research programme. We are particularly interested in candidates who combine deep scientific curiosity with a motivation to translate ideas into practical conservation impact. Experience working in conservation genetics or genomics is thus essential.Your tasks- Conduct high-quality research on conservation genomics, genetic monitoring and integration of genetic diversity into policy.- Develop and apply approaches for monitoring and protecting genetic diversity in wild populations in Germany and at focal international sites.- Work on connecting genetic diversity with national and international policy.- Collaborate with researchers, conservation organisations, and other stakeholders.- Publish findings in high-quality peer-reviewed journals and present results at international conferences.- Communicate research findings to non-academic audiences, including through policy briefs and communication with conservation managers, and policymakers.- Supervise BSc and/or MSc thesis students.- Help develop international funding proposals for genetic diversity protection and monitoring.Your profile- A PhD in population/conservation/evolutionary genomics or a related field.- At least one year of postdoctoral research experience.- Hands-on experience with genomic datasets.- Experience in conservation biology and biodiversity protection, including collaboration with conservation practitioners, managers, or policy makers.- A strong publication record appropriate to your career stage.Desirable skills- Excellent scientific writing and communication skills in English.- Experience or a strong interest in developing research proposals and securing third-party funding.- A collaborative, collegial and well-organised approach to research and teamwork.We offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.Senckenberg is certified under the audit berufundfamilie programme and is committed to promoting a better work-life balance.How to apply?Please upload your applicationelectronically as a single PDF by 05.12.2026, containing:- A letter of motivation (1-2 pages), including clear explanations about your interest in the position and an outline of how your experience fits the research programme.- CV and publication list.- PhD certificate.- Contact details for two academic refereesPlease upload your application by clicking on the "Apply Online" button in the bottom of this announcement. Applications via email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Deborah Leighat deborah.leigh@senckenberg.de

Unsere tarifliche Vergütung bietet zudem Transparenz sowie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld.MobilitätszuschussWir unterstützen nachhaltige Mobilität mit einem Zuschuss zum BVG-Jobticket und bieten gesicherte Fahrradstellplätze im Innenhof.Gesundheit & FitnessWir fördern die Gesundheit unserer Mitarbeitenden mit Sport- und Yogakursen sowie der Teilnahme an Laufevents. Bei Bedarf unterstützen wir auch bei der Anschaffung einer Lesehilfe.Entwicklung & WeiterbildungWir fördern Ideen und Entwicklung durch vielfältige Weiterbildungsangebote und individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der WBM.Über UnsWir, die WBM Wohnungsbaugesellschaft Berlin-Mitte mbH, sind so vielfältig wie das Leben in der Metropole Berlin: In unseren rund 35.000 Mietwohnungen leben ca.85.000 Berlinerinnen aus über 100 Nationen. Wir vermieten und verwalten etwa 314.000 m² Gewerbeflächen, so viele wie keine andere der sechs landeseigenen Wohnungsbaugesellschaften. Wir stehen für bezahlbaren Wohn- und attraktiven Gewerberaum mitten in der Hauptstadt und machen unsere Bestände fit für die Zukunft. Immobilienwirtschaftliche Kompetenz bringt die WBM zudem als Partnerin des Landes Berlin bei der Entwicklung komplexer Quartiere ein. Über 480 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter gestalten und schaffen attraktive und lebenswerte Kieze zum Wohnen und Arbeiten. Für ein soziales, nachhaltiges und klimaneutrales Berlin investieren wir verstärkt in Innovationen und Digitalisierung. title: ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
description: ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)Location: Luxembourg, LU Company: Deutsche Börse Group Your area of work:Clearstream is a large international financial institution offering post-trade infrastructure and securities services for the international and domestic markets worldwide.The ICT risk management control function plays a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization against technological and information security risks. We partner closely with product, technology, security, and risk teams to ensure the resilience of our systems and services. We actively manage technology risks, steer ICT risk governance and framework design, perform focused risk assurance, and enable compliance for legal entities, branches, and representative offices in scope with direct reporting line to the corresponding executive boards.The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management practices, and regulations, also comfortable working cross functionally. Your responsibilities:• Monitor technology and security risks, providing independent oversight, and challenging the first line of defense when necessary.• Assist in developing, implementing and maintaining a DORA-complaint ICT Risk oversight program while working closely with ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Assurance, and other relevant teams.• Support the oversight of digital operational resilience posture and advise on necessary technology risk control requirements. Stay updated with emerging trends and align these with organizational plans.• Work with relevant functions across the three lines of defense to gather digital resilience requirements, ensure alignment, and meet compliance expectations.• Offer insights from a technology risk perspective on key digital transformation initiatives, resilience testing, ICT third party supplier risk, and other key areas.• Assist in aligning digital operational resilience with strategic goals. Provide recommendations based on evolving threats, risk appetite, business strategy, and regulatory changes.• Define, monitor, and report on risk metrics and key performance indicators. Support the preparation and delivery of ICT risk reports to senior management.• Lead ICT risk regulatory watch and intelligence activities, continuously monitoring evolving regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA), industry standards, and supervisory expectations• Translate regulatory developments into actionable insights and impacts for the organization.• Proactively advise stakeholders on upcoming changes and required adaptations to maintain compliance and resilience. Your profile:• 5+ years of experience in technology governance, risk, and compliance.• University degree in Computer Science, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, or related field.• Strong understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management principles, and comfortable working cross functionally.• Experience and analytical skills understanding, structuring, and explaining complex topics; end-to-end thinking required.• Can turn incomplete, unstructured, or ambiguous data points into structured outcomes and pragmatic action plans.• Experience working with technology regulations, international standards, or best practices.• Stakeholders' management skills and capacity to manage priorities simultaneously.• High self-responsibility & ownership; result orientation and customer focus.• Proficiency in written and spoken English (must), as well as in German (nice to have).

title: Director - Client Service & Product Architecture (f/m/d)

Your responsibilities: Client Service Strategy & Leadership• Define and execute the end-to-end client service strategy, covering support, incident response, and ongoing day to day client interactions.• Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing client service team supporting institutional clients across multiple regions.• Establish client-centric KPIs, quality standards, and SLAs aligned with business objectives and regulatory expectations.• Promote a strong client-success culture across the company. Operational Support & Issue Resolution• Lead the day-to-day operations of the Client Service function, ensuring timely response to client requests, tickets, and escalations.• Oversee incident management, root-cause analysis, and communication for service disruptions or critical issues.• Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on metrics, trends, and post-incident reviews.• Ensure all support processes adhere to security, data protection, and operational risk standards. Client Relationship & Communication• Act as a senior point of escalation for key clients, building trust through transparency, accountability, and proactive engagement.• Conduct regular service reviews with major clients to discuss performance, roadmap updates, and improvement opportunities.• Provide clear communication on product changes, maintenance schedules, and operational impacts. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Influence• Work closely with Product Engineering, QA, Compliance, and Clearstream teams to relay client feedback and ensure alignment on support priorities.• Influence product roadmap decisions by systematically capturing client needs, pain points, and usage patterns.• Support regulatory and audit requirements relating to service quality, operational resilience, and client communications. Tools, Processes & Governance• Select and manage customer support tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and monitoring solutions.• Define standard operating procedures (SOPs), support guidelines, and escalation paths.• Ensure accurate and up-to-date documentation for clients and internal teams (knowledge base, runbooks, FAQs).• Support audit readiness and compliance checks related to client service operations. Your profile: • Leadership & Experience: 8–12+ years of experience in client service or customer success, including several years of experience building, scaling, and leading teams.• Industry Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of fintech, financial services, or regulated environments, with preferred knowledge of Transfer Agency, fund distribution, or market infrastructure.• Technical Aptitude: Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, APIs, microservices, and complex integration-driven products; exposure to blockchain/DLT is a strong asset.• Institutional Client Management: Proven ability to manage institutional clients, build strong relationships, and successfully resolve complex technical escalations.• Operational Excellence: A data-driven, problem-solving mindset with experience managing KPIs, SLAs, and incident-management processes in critical environments.• Collaboration & Onboarding: Strong project-management skills to coordinate client onboarding and collaborate effectively with cross-functional product and engineering teams.• Adaptability & Communication: Exceptional communication and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment.

description: Du sorgst dafür, dass Unternehmen verbunden bleiben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass du den passenden Job findest.Ein Netzwerk ist für dich mehr als ein paar Switches, Router und blinkende LEDs? description: 1 Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d) Arbeitsort: SopronDarum dreht sich Ihre Rolle * Analyse, Vorbereitung und Konzeption ** Sie analysieren die bestehende Fertigung bei unserem bisherigen Lieferanten direkt vor Ort und dokumentieren die Abläufe lückenlos. ** Auf Basis der Daten setzen Sie das bestehende Fertigungskonzept konkret um und bringen sich aktiv in die Feinplanung sowie das Hallenlayout ein, um von Beginn an maximale Effizienz zu sichern. * Prototypenbau, Optimierung und Schnittstellenarbeit ** Sie koordinieren, steuern und unterstützen das Team beim Aufbau des Prototyps auf Basis des zugelieferten Bausatzes. ** Sie analysieren die Effizienz, vervollständigen notwendige Prozessdokumentationen im Dialog mit den Beteiligten und bauen ein System zur Qualitätssicherung in allen Fertigungsschritten auf. ** Sie geben technisches Feedback an das technische Büro zurück und arbeiten eng mit den zentralen Abteilungen (Technik und Projektleitung), der lokalen Geschäfts- und Werksleitung sowie den lokalen Meister:innen zusammen. * Serienüberführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Logistik ** Sie bereiten die AV vor, legen Losgrößen für Einzelteile fest und sichern die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Halbzeugen im Standardablauf des neuen Partners. ** Sie erstellen den Fertigungs- und Kapazitätsplan passgenau auf Basis unserer Bestellungen und Liefertermine. ** Sie überführen den Prototypen erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung und wirken parallel an der Entwicklung neuer Prototypen mit. ** Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass das Endprodukt nach unseren vorgegebenen Standards verpackt und transportiert wird. ** Sie führen und motivieren Ihr Team von 4-10 Personen mit klarem Blick für das gemeinsame Ziel.Diese Kenntnisse können Sie verwerten * Sie verfügen über einen Meistertitel in einem metallverarbeitenden Beruf oder einen HTL-Abschluss mit Matura. Zudem bringen Sie solide handwerkliche Erfahrung und idealerweise bereits Einblicke in die Arbeitsvorbereitung mit. * Sie bringen idealerweise fundierte Praxis aus dem Stahlbau oder der Fertigungstechnologie mit. * Sie haben nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Fertigung komplexer technischer Vorrichtungen sowie in der Serienfertigung. * Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Detailorientierung aus, bringen Ideen konsequent auf die Straße und lassen sich auch von engen Zeitplänen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. * Da Sie viele Schnittstellen koordinieren, überzeugen Sie durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und die Fähigkeit, gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden. * Sie haben bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeiter:innen gesammelt und verstehen es, Ihr Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren. * Kenntnisse über Arbeitssicherheit und Arbeitnehmer:innenschutz im modernen Fertigungsumfeld sind für Sie selbstverständlich. * Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. This will include AI, automation, intelligent workflows, self-service and digital adoption across the global HR function.This is your new role- Define and lead the global HR technology, digitalisation and transformation strategy, supported by a clear multi-year roadmap and governance model.- Lead the global HR technology landscape, including SAP SuccessFactors, and oversee the transition from Workday to SAP SuccessFactors.- Drive major HR technology transformation, migration, optimisation and continuous improvement programmes.- Define and embed the HR AI, automation and digital innovation strategy, ensuring responsible governance, security and privacy.- Create simple, digital-first employee and manager experiences through self-service, automation and improved HR processes.- Establish strong governance for HR systems, integrations, data quality, security, reporting and analytics.- Enable workforce insights and data-driven decision-making through effective HR reporting and analytics.- Lead global change management, adoption and capability-building across HR, including AI fluency and digital ways of working.- Partner with HR, IT, Finance, Procurement and business leaders to ensure technology investments deliver measurable business value.- Build and lead a high-performing HR Technology and Digitalisation function, fostering innovation and continuous improvement.This is you:- You bring 10+ years of experience in HR Technology, Digital HR, HR Transformation or a related field within a large, complex global organisation.- You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (BSc/MSc) in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.- You have a proven track record of leading enterprise-scale HR technology transformations, including major implementations, migrations and platform changes.- You have strong experience with SAP SuccessFactors and/or Workday, combined with a solid understanding of HR systems, integrations and digital HR ecosystems.- You understand HR data, analytics, governance, security, privacy and compliance, and how these enable effective global HR services.- You are passionate about AI, automation and emerging technologies, with the ability to identify opportunities that improve HR efficiency and employee experience.- You can translate digital strategy into clear roadmaps, investment priorities and measurable business outcomes.- You are a strong change leader and communicator, able to influence senior HR, IT and business stakeholders across a global matrix organisation.- You combine strategic thinking with hands-on leadership, building strong teams, challenging legacy ways of working and driving digital adoption and continuous improvement.Why work for us?- lexible working arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance.- A permanent employment contract with a competitive salary and attractive employee benefits.- Excellent learning and career development opportunities, supported by the Nexperia Academy and dedicated talent and leadership programmes- Access to a range of additional benefits, which may include retirement provisions, mobility support, employee discounts and wellbeing initiatives, depending on location.- Access to employee assistance and wellbeing support programmes.- Opportunities to connect through social clubs, Employee Resource Groups and global initiatives.- The opportunity to work in a global technology environment, collaborating across functions and regions on strategic transformation initiatives.- A role with significant scope to shape the future of HR technology, digitalisation and AI at Nexperia.Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilitiesYour profile- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)- Fluent in English and preferably GermanBenefits- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discountsYour next step - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Fenris Creations is looking for a Senior Software Engineer!The infrastructure team owns the core platform that powers EVE Online, building a reliable foundation that will scale and grow with our players over time. As a senior engineer on the team, you’ll own large, open-ended projects, such as making login faster and safer, letting a node fail without ending a fleet engagement, or finding where the latency in an RPC path goes. You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

title: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍK
description: HEAD CHEF AT A MICHELIN GUIDE-RECOMMENDED RESTAURANT IN REYKJAVÍKAre you ready to make your mark on one of Iceland’s most exciting culinary destinations?We are seeking a creative and ambitious Head Chef for a well-established fine dining restaurant in Reykjavík. Selected by the MICHELIN Guide, the restaurant offers contemporary Icelandic cuisine with strong roots in the country’s culinary heritage.This is a rare opportunity to lead a dedicated kitchen team, develop your own culinary direction and work with some of the Nordic region’s most distinctive ingredients.ABOUT THE RESTAURANTThe restaurant serves modern Icelandic cuisine, with seasonality, sustainability and local ingredients at its heart. The menus evolve with the seasons, showcasing the best Iceland has to offer—from fish, shellfish and lamb to wild herbs, seaweed and produce from local suppliers.The restaurant has recently moved to new premises with a larger, upgraded kitchen. The incoming Head Chef will have considerable creative freedom to develop the menus and help shape the restaurant’s future culinary direction.THE ROLEAs Head Chef, you will have overall responsibility for the kitchen’s culinary direction and operations. You will lead the team in its daily work, ensuring consistently exceptional standards throughout every service.Your responsibilities will include:    Leading, developing and motivating the kitchen team    Creating seasonal menus    Maintaining quality and consistency throughout every service    Establishing clear planning, structure and efficient kitchen workflows    Working closely with local, sustainably sourced ingredients    Further developing the restaurant’s identity and culinary direction    Creating a professional, safe and inclusive kitchen cultureWHO WE ARE LOOKING FORWe are looking for a creative, ambitious chef who is confident in a professional kitchen. You have a strong fine dining background and understand the precision, quality and attention to the overall guest experience expected at MICHELIN Guide level.You may already be working as a Head Chef, or you may be an outstanding Sous Chef ready to take the next step into a leadership role.We believe you bring:    Substantial experience in fine dining or another high-level culinary environment    Experience in menu development and working with seasonal ingredients    A clear, hands-on leadership style    The ability to bring structure, quality and a positive working atmosphere to the kitchen    A genuine interest in sustainability and local ingredients    The ability to balance creativity with quality, financial discipline and reliable operations    Strong communication skills in an international working environmentExperience at a Michelin restaurant or an equivalent culinary level is an advantage, but potential, leadership and ambition can be equally important.A KITCHEN WITH A STRONG TRADITION OF WOMEN IN GASTRONOMYFor the past ten years, the restaurant’s kitchen has been staffed by an all-female team. The restaurant is deeply committed to supporting women in gastronomy and creating opportunities for female chefs to develop into leaders.We want to continue building a workplace where women can grow, make an impact and take on culinary leadership roles. We welcome qualified applicants of all genders and select candidates based on their skills, leadership, motivation and potential.WHAT’S ON OFFER    A key leadership role at a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide    Considerable creative freedom to shape the menus and culinary direction    A larger, recently upgraded restaurant kitchen    Access to unique Icelandic ingredients and local producers    The opportunity to lead and develop an ambitious kitchen team    An international career opportunity in Reykjavík    Accommodation options, discussed individually    Salary, start date and other terms by agreementABOUT REYKJAVÍKReykjavík offers a rare combination of urban creativity, a vibrant restaurant scene and spectacular natural surroundings. The sea, mountains, hot springs and some of the Nordic region’s most exciting ingredients are all close at hand.For the right person, this is more than a new job. It is an opportunity to create something of your own while discovering a new country, a new food culture and a new way of life.HOW TO APPLYThe recruitment process is managed by Wildcard Untap, which helps hospitality businesses find skilled specialists and leaders through proactive search, personal dialogue and professional judgement.Please send your CV and a brief introduction outlining your experience, leadership approach and culinary philosophy to:jobb@wildcarduntap.comPlease use the subject line: “Head Chef – Reykjavík”Applications will be reviewed and interviews held on an ongoing basis. All applications will be treated confidentially.

title: HEADCHEF TILL MICHELIN GUIDE-REKOMMENDERAD RESTAURANG I REYKJAVÍK
description: Är du redo att sätta din egen prägel på en av Islands mest spännande gastronomiska destinationer?Nu söker vi en kreativ och ambitiös Head Chef till en välrenommerad fine dining-restaurang i Reykjavík. Restaurangen är utvald av MICHELIN Guide (2026) och erbjuder samtida isländsk gastronomi med tydliga rötter i landets matkultur.Det här är en sällsynt möjlighet för dig som vill leda ett engagerat köksteam, utveckla en egen kulinarisk riktning och arbeta nära några av Nordens mest särpräglade råvaror.OM RESTAURANGENRestaurangen arbetar med modern isländsk matlagning där säsong, hållbarhet och lokala råvaror står i centrum. Menyerna följer årstiderna och bygger på det bästa som Island har att erbjuda – från fisk, skaldjur och lamm till vilda örter, tång och råvaror från lokala producenter.Verksamheten har nyligen flyttat till nya lokaler med ett större och uppgraderat kök. Den nya kökschefen får därför stor kreativ frihet att utveckla menyerna och vara med och forma restaurangens framtida gastronomiska inriktning.ROLLENSom Head Chef får du det övergripande kulinariska och operativa ansvaret för köket. Du leder teamet i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att varje servering håller en jämn och mycket hög nivå.Rollen omfattar bland annat:    Ledning, utveckling och motivation av köksteamet    Utveckling av säsongsbaserade menyer    Kvalitetssäkring och konsekvent nivå i varje servering    Planering, struktur och ett effektivt arbetsflöde i köket    Nära arbete med lokala och hållbara råvaror    Att vidareutveckla restaurangens identitet och gastronomiska riktning    Att skapa en professionell, trygg och inkluderande kökskulturVEM SÖKER VI?Vi söker dig som är kreativ, ambitiös och trygg i ett professionellt kök. Du har en stark bakgrund inom fine dining och förstår de krav på precision, kvalitet och helhetsupplevelse som ställs på MICHELIN Guide-nivå.Du kan redan arbeta som Head Chef, men vi välkomnar även en mycket skicklig Sous Chef som är redo att ta nästa steg in i en ledande roll.Vi tror att du har:    Gedigen erfarenhet från fine dining eller annan gastronomisk verksamhet på hög nivå    Erfarenhet av menyutveckling och arbete med säsongsbaserade råvaror    Ett tydligt och närvarande ledarskap    Förmåga att skapa struktur, kvalitet och arbetsglädje i köket    Ett genuint intresse för hållbarhet och lokala råvaror    Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med kvalitet, ekonomi och stabil drift    God kommunikativ förmåga i en internationell arbetsmiljöErfarenhet från en Michelin-restaurang eller motsvarande gastronomisk nivå är meriterande, men rätt potential, ledarskap och ambition kan vara lika viktigt.ETT KÖK MED EN STARK KVINNLIG TRADITIONUnder de senaste tio åren har restaurangens kök bestått av ett kvinnligt team. Verksamheten har ett starkt engagemang för att stödja kvinnor inom gastronomin och skapa möjligheter för kvinnliga kockar att utvecklas till ledare.Vi vill fortsätta bygga en arbetsplats där kvinnor kan växa, påverka och ta plats i gastronomiska ledarroller. Samtidigt välkomnar vi kvalificerade sökande oavsett kön och gör urvalet utifrån kompetens, ledarskap, motivation och potential.DET HÄR ERBJUDS    En central ledarroll på en MICHELIN Guide-rekommenderad restaurang    Stor kreativ frihet att påverka menyer och gastronomisk inriktning    Ett större och nyligen uppgraderat restaurangkök    Tillgång till unika isländska råvaror och lokala producenter    Möjlighet att leda och utveckla ett ambitiöst köksteam    En internationell karriärmöjlighet i Reykjavík    Boendemöjligheter finns och diskuteras individuellt    Lön, startdatum och övriga villkor enligt överenskommelseOM REYKJAVÍKReykjavík erbjuder en ovanlig kombination av kreativ storstad, levande restaurangkultur och storslagen natur. Här finns havet, bergen, varma källor och några av Nordens mest intressanta råvaror alldeles i närheten.För rätt person är detta mer än ett nytt arbete. Det är möjligheten att skapa något eget och samtidigt uppleva ett nytt land, en ny matkultur och en ny vardag.ANSÖKANRekryteringen genomförs av Wildcard Untap, som hjälper verksamheter inom hotell och restaurang att hitta kvalificerade specialister och ledare genom aktiv search, personlig dialog och professionellt omdöme.Skicka CV och en kort presentation av din erfarenhet, ditt ledarskap och din gastronomiska filosofi till:jobb@wildcarduntap.comMärk ansökan: ”Head Chef – Reykjavík”Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Alla ansökningar behandlas konfidentiellt.

title: Ræstingar ofl.
description: Leitað er eftir starfsmanni í hlutastarf við Orlofsbyggðina á Illugastöðum í Fnjóskadal. Starfið felst aðallega í þrifum á orlofshúsum á staðnum sem og afleysingum við þau störf sem til falla hjá Orlofsbyggðinni einnig getur verið um að ræða fullt starf yfir sumartímann. Engrar sérstakrar menntunar er krafist en hæfni og reynsla á þrifum er skilyrði. Ensku kunnátta og lágmarks íslensku kunnátta þarf að vera til staðar. Starfshlutfall getur verið misjafnt á milli mánaða en vinnutími er kl. 9 - 17 þá daga sem unnið er en vinnutími getur þó verið sveigjanlegur upp að vissu marki sé það ósk starfsmanns. Laun eru greidd skv. tímaskráningu hvers mánaðar miðað við launataxta SGS við SA. Starfsmaður þarf almennt ekki að sjá um sig sjálfur til og frá vinnu svo ekki er skilyrði að viðkomandi hafi örkuréttindi eða eigin bíl til umráða en það er vissulega mikill kostur. Ef upp kemur sú staða að starfsmaður komi á eigin vegum / eigin bíl er greiddur akstursstyrkur sem og gjaldið í Vaðlaheiðargöng er greitt fyrir viðkomandi.

title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com
