title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. description: Il nostro Cliente è un importante gruppo industriale italiano, leader nella manifattura per il settore food & beverage, con presenza internazionale e un percorso di sviluppo fondato su innovazione, investimenti e solidità operativa. Gestirà relazioni con fornitori italiani e internazionali (OEM, integratori, service provider) e, per investimenti o accordi quadro rilevanti, supporterà l'escalation verso General Management e Proprietà. È possibile un contributo su iniziative corporate di standardizzazione/razionalizzazione con estensione internazionale. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description: We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a3D Production Manager (m/f/d)Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmYOUR TASKS:- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters- Actively contributing to the further development of our companyYOUR PROFILE:- Experience in leadership- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness- Fluent English (business level)OUR TOP 3 REASONS:- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design- Responsibility right from the start- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international companyAfter an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.-------------------Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen3D Production Manager (m/w/d)Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, StockholmDEINE AUFGABEN:Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter WorkflowsAufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in HanoiÜberwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von ProzessenOrganisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen ZentraleAktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres UnternehmensDEIN PROFIL:FührungserfahrungErfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-WorkflowsErfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von VorteilFreude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter KommunikationHohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie ZuverlässigkeitStrukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte ArbeitsweiseHohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und DurchsetzungsstärkeFließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte UnternehmenskulturVerantwortung von Anfang anKurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen UnternehmenNach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description: The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineerRequired:-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)-German Endorsement for COC Master Course-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card-Excellent and fluent English language skills-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.Desired:- Previous SAR experience- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.

  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.

  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Rahoitusasiantuntija
description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Se opastaa työympäristön peruskäytöstä aina vaativiin yritysrahoituksen tilanteisiin.Opiskelet omaan tahtiisi, harjoittelet käytännön tilanteita ja osoitat osaamisesi osaamiskokeilla. Etenemisestä saat osaamismerkkejä. **Harjoituksia voit uusia rajattomasti.****Mitä teet Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijana?**- hankit yritysasiakkaita ja avaat keskustelun yrittäjien kanssa heidän hankkeistaan - kartoitat rahoitustarpeen ja kokoat tilinpäätös- ja tapaamistiedot - tarkistat rahoitusanalyysin ja käyt Asiakasraportin läpi asiakkaan kanssa - valmistelet Rahoittajapaketin ja huolehdit sovituista jatkotoimista - pidät asiakkaan ajan tasalla hankkeen loppuun saakka **Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti.** Ymmärrät asiakkaan tilanteen ja rakennat sille oikean rahoitusratkaisun. **Trusty Finance on yritykselle maksuton**, mikä madaltaa kynnystä aloittaa keskustelu.**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**Voit tulla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnin, yritysasiakastyön, pankin, rahoituksen tai taloushallinnon parista. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. Voit toimia oman yrityksen kautta tai kevytyrittäjänä, tai voit perustaa yrityksen aloituksen yhteydessä. **Yhteistyö edellyttää Y-tunnusta.** Voit hakea myös, jos olet valmis hankkimaan sen ennen aloittamista.**Ansainta perustuu toteutuneisiin rahoituksiin**Ansaitset provisiota toteutuneista rahoituksista. Aktiivisella tekemisellä ansaintatavoite on **noin 2 000–10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**, ja kokeneilla tekijöillä **yli 10 000 euroa kuukaudessa**. **Palkkiokattoa ei ole.**Kyse on yrittäjän provisiotulosta, ei kiinteästä palkasta eikä taatusta ansiosta. Ansainta riippuu toteutuneista rahoituksista, ja käteen jäävään tuloon vaikuttavat omat yrityskulut ja verot.**Mitä tarjoamme?**- **Trusty Finance Broker** -työympäristön koko asiakastyöhön - **FSG Trusty Finance Akatemian**, jossa osaamisesi kasvaa vaihe vaiheelta - **laajan suomalaisten ja pohjoismaisten rahoittajien verkoston** - oman trustyfinance.fi-sähköpostiosoitteen - perehdytyksen ja tuen perustajatiimiltä - mahdollisuuden edetä vaativampiin asiakassuhteisiin ja suurempiin rahoitushankkeisiin FSG Financial Services Groupin perustajatiimillä on yhteensä **yli 95 vuotta kokemusta** rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta. Tämä kokemus on tukenasi alusta alkaen.**Mitä tarvitset aloittaaksesi?**- oman tietokoneen, puhelimen ja internetyhteyden - sujuvan suomen kielen taidon ja ammattimaisen otteen asiakasviestintään - Y-tunnuksen tai valmiuden hankkia se ennen yhteistyön alkua **Hae Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijaksi**Haluatko ottaa vastuun koko rahoitushankkeesta ja rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi uuden työympäristön tuella? Kerro hakemuksessa taustastasi ja vahvuuksistasi sekä siitä, miksi yritysasiakkaiden auttaminen kiinnostaa sinua.Tutustu rekrytointiprosessiin ja lähetä hakemuksesi.Suora linkki hakemukseen: https://www.financialservicesgroup.fi/rekry/haku**Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti ja etenemme sopivien hakijoiden kanssa nopeasti.**

title: IT Category Lead Buyer (m/f)
description: IT Category Lead BuyerLocations Luxembourgtime type Full timejob requisition id JR000777Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 470 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:‎ IT Category Lead BuyerYour roleReporting to the Central Procurement Manager, the IT Category Lead Buyer will be the primary procurement contact for an assigned portfolio of IT goods and services.The position combines category management with hands-on procurement execution. The IT Category Lead Buyer will work closely with IT service owners, Information Security, Legal, Finance, Accounts Payable and suppliers to ensure that purchases and renewals are commercially sound, appropriately approved, contractually covered and delivered on time.Your responsibilitiesSupport to Procurement strategy and sourcing for IT Category• Support strategy definition and deployment for assigned IT spend areas, including, as applicable, software, SaaS, hardware, maintenance, support, telecommunications and IT professional services• Analyse expenditure, supplier concentration, contract coverage, internal demand, renewal dates and purchasing patterns• Define the appropriate sourcing route for each requirement, such as competitive tender, quotation process, framework call-off, reseller competition or direct negotiation.• Prepare RFQs and RFPs, coordinate supplier responses, perform commercial comparisons and document procurement recommendations.• Monitor supplier-market developments and provide practical procurement guidance to IT stakeholdersContract renewals management• Maintain a reliable IT contract and renewal pipeline in the CLM platform , with clear milestones, responsibilities and escalation points.• undefined• Coordinate renewal activities between IT owners, suppliers, Legal, Finance, Data Protection and Information Security.• Ensure that required supplier due diligence, security assessments and internal validations are initiated and completed before purchase, renewal or contract signature.• undefined• Track contractual documentation, approvals, negotiation status, signature and purchase-order readiness.• undefined• Escalate late decisions, unresolved security findings, unacceptable supplier terms or potential service-interruption risks to the Central Procurement Manager and the appropriate IT owner. Operational purchase management• Ensure that purchase orders are issued before supplier delivery or invoicing, except where an authorised exception applies.• Confirm alignment among the purchase order, quotation, contract and approved budget.• Support compliance with procurement procedures, delegated authorities and approved buying channels.• Maintain complete and accurate procurement records in the relevant purchasing and contract-management systems.• Maintain clear trackers for sourcing initiatives, renewals, approvals, security reviews, contracts, purchase orders and invoice exceptions.• Assign actions and target dates to the relevant stakeholders and follow up consistently until closure.Procurement governance and performance management• Deploy Central Procurement policies, procedures, controls and standard templates across the assigned IT category.• Act as the procurement governance point of contact for IT owners, guiding stakeholders through the appropriate sourcing, approval, contracting and purchasing route• Promote the use of approved suppliers, framework agreements, standard contractual terms and consolidated buying channels across the IT category.• Monitor IT suppliers relationships and performance through business reviews, annual scorecards, collection of stakeholders feedback and follow-up of corrective action plansYour profile• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology or a related discipline.• 3–5 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, contract management or purchasing operations.• Professional fluency in English and French• Practical exposure to IT procurement and existing IT suppliers network, preferably covering one or more of the following: software and SaaS; IT hardware; maintenance and support; telecommunications; cloud or hosting services; IT professional or managed services.• Good understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, including requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, goods or service receipt and invoice matching.• Ability to understand commercial IT models such as subscriptions, licences, maintenance, consumption-based services and professional-services engagements.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spend, pricing, contract and purchasing data.• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewals and operational priorities simultaneously.• Collaborative and service-oriented approach when working with IT, Finance, Legal, Information Security and business stakeholders.‎Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm. With over 50 nationalities represented, Arendt is committed to the well-being of its staff, serving the best interests of its clients, protecting the environment, and supporting education.Arendt promotes equal opportunities and value each employee for what they bring to the community. For more information, please refer to our diversity and inclusion policy on our website.Interested?If you are interested in this job opportunity, we are looking forward to receiving your application.All applications will be treated confidentially.Please be aware that the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record (or certificate of good conduct).

title: Production Manager (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:LUXUAV is an innovative technology company headquartered in Luxembourg, shaping next-generation airspace security for defence, civil, firefighting and police missions.We build a fully integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) ecosystem that connects mission systems across ground, air, and stratosphere into one coherent governmental and commercial architecture.Job Title: Production ManagerReports to: Chief Operating OfficerRole overview:The Production Manager is responsible for leading the company's production operations, ensuring the safe, efficient and timely manufacture of high-quality unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The role manages the production team, oversees daily manufacturing activities, and works closely with Engineering, Industrialisation and Quality to deliver products that meet customer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.The Production Manager is accountable for production planning, workforce management, productivity, quality, continuous improvement and operational performance while fostering a positive and engaged team culture.Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Operations• Lead and manage all daily production activities to ensure safe, efficient andon-time delivery of products.• Develop and execute production schedules and targets.• Monitor production progress and adjust resources to meet changing priorities.• Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality and safety standards.• Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput.• Ensure effective utilisation of labour, equipment, and production resources.Team Leadership• Lead, coach, develop and motivate the production team.• Manage workforce planning, shift allocation and daily work assignments.• Manage performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.• Manage day-to-day employee relations issues within the production team, partnering with HR on formal or complex cases.• Identify training and development needs to enhance team capability.• Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.Quality• Ensure products are manufactured in accordance with quality requirements; and approved engineering drawings, specifications, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and work instructions developed by the R&D team.• Work closely with the Quality Manager to resolve production quality issues.• Promote a "right first time" approach throughout production.• Ensure production teams understand and comply with quality procedures.• Support non-conformance investigations and implement corrective actions.Production Planning & Performance• Ensure production plan is aligned to meet sales plan and/or customer delivery deadlines.• Ensure production plan and corresponding timely materials procurement requests are factored into the procurement plan.• Monitor production KPIs including output, efficiency, labour utilisation, schedule adherence, rework and productivity.• Analyse production performance and recommend improvements.• Prepare production reports for management.• Support capacity planning and future production growth.Health, Safety & Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.• Ensure employees follow safe working practices and company procedures.• Participate in risk assessments and incident investigations.• Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment.Continuous Improvement• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within production (e.g. 5S program implementation).• Improve production workflows, layouts and processes.• Reduce waste, rework and production downtime.• Support Lean manufacturing and other operational excellence initiatives.• Encourage employee suggestions for operational improvements.Inventory & Materials• Work closely with Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure material availability.• Monitor inventory accuracy within the production area.• Ensure appropriate handling and storage of components and finished products.• Minimise material waste and production losses.Cross-functional Collaboration• Collaborate with Engineering and Industrialisation to introduce new products into production.• Support prototype, pilot and low-rate initial production (LRIP) builds.• Provide manufacturing feedback to improve product design and manufacturability.• Support production readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.Equipment & Facilities• Ensure production equipment is maintained and available.• Report equipment issues and coordinate maintenance activities.• Recommend investments in tools, equipment, and production capability.Qualifications & ExperienceMust have• Bachelor's degree or vocational qualification in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will also be considered.• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.• Previous experience leading production teams.• Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production planning.• Understanding of quality management systems and manufacturing quality principles.• Familiarity with health and safety requirements within manufacturing.• Strong leadership and people management skills.• Excellent organisational and planning abilities.• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.• Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret production data.• Free criminal record no. 3Nice to have• Experience within electronics, aerospace, defence, automotive, or other high- technology manufacturing environments is advantageous.• Experience introducing new products into production is desirable.• Experience using ERP or manufacturing planning systems is advantageous.• National from a NATO member country or one of the following NATO Indo- Pacific partners: Australia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand or Ukraine.

title: SENIOR SCIENTIST IN AGENTIC AI FOR ENVIRONMENTAL DIGITAL TWINS (m/f)

description: Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. Relevant initiatives include Destination Earth (DestinE), ESA Digital Twin Earth and EO Digital Twin Components, as well as EU-funded ecosystem and biodiversity digital-twin projects such as TerraTwin and BioDT. Complementary initiatives, including the European Green Deal Data Space and the Common European Agricultural Data Space, provide a framework for interoperable and trusted data sharing across stakeholders. The selected researcher will be mainly in charge of:• Designing and evaluating LLM-based, tool-using and multi-agent systems to orchestrate EO data access, geospatial processing, environmental models, simulations and digital-twin services.• Translating natural-language questions into traceable model configurations and executable workflows, with robust planning, verification, spatial/temporal reasoning, uncertainty handling and explainable outputs.• Contributing to ongoing interdisciplinary RDI projects and co-developing scalable, reproducible solutions with EO scientists, environmental modellers and infrastructure specialists.• Connecting AI workflows with cloud/HPC environments, research infrastructures and, where relevant, distributed sensing and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication systems, working with infrastructure specialists to support interoperable access to IoT sensor streams, satellite observations, weather data and model services across stakeholders, with appropriate data governance and traceability.• Initiating and leading new interdisciplinary research projects, partnerships and competitive proposals; supervising researchers; and disseminating and valorising results. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education• PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Geoinformatics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related discipline. Experience and skills• Established scientific track record in AI, with demonstrated hands-on expertise in LLMs and agentic AI systems, including tool use, planning, orchestration and interaction with external APIs, data services or scientific models.• Strong understanding of modern foundation-model methods and development frameworks, such as retrieval-augmented generation, context engineering, multi-agent architectures and systematic model/agent evaluation.• Ability to design robust, reproducible computational workflows with appropriate validation, uncertainty assessment, traceability and interpretability; strong programming skills.• Working knowledge of EO/geospatial data and an aptitude for spatial and temporal reasoning; motivation to apply advanced AI to practical environmental and societal challenges.• Collaborative and interdisciplinary mindset, with the ability to contribute to ongoing research activities and leverage complementary expertise in Earth Observation, environmental sciences and modelling.• Demonstrated experience in scientific leadership, developing competitive research proposals, building national and international collaborations, supervising researchers and publishing high-quality scientific work. Language skills• Fluency in spoken and written English; French, German and/or Luxembourgish would be an asset. title: Instructeur de natation“ (m/w/d) mit CATP / DAP und Meisterbrief
description: Die Stadtverwaltung Grevenmacher stellt für das städtische Freibad einen Arbeitsnehmer (m/w/d) mit manueller Tätigkeit im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ mit CATP / DAP ein.Arbeitsvertrag: unbefristet.Beschäftigungsgrad: 100%.Einstellung: ab März 2027Einstellungsbedingungen:–      Staatsangehöriger eines Mitgliedstaates der EU;–      Sprachkenntnisse in Luxemburgisch, Deutsch und Französisch;–      Besitz der zivilen und politischen Rechte;–      Führerschein der Klasse B;–      CATP / DAP im Beruf „instructeur de natation“ (oder ein vom Ministerium für Erziehung und Berufsausbildung als gleichwertig anerkanntes ausländisches Diplom)Der Kandidat muss im Besitz eines Meisterbriefes als geprüfter Meister für Bäderbetriebe sein. Aufgaben:–      Überwachung der Schwimmbecken;–      Kontrolle und Wartung aller sich im Freibad befindlichen technischen Anlagen;–      Außerhalb der Freibadsaison hat der Arbeitnehmer jede ihm übertragene aufgetragene Arbeit zu verrichten, seinen Kräften und Fähigkeiten entsprechende andere Aufgaben anzunehmen und diese gewissenhaft und ordnungsgemäß auszuführen, auch wenn diese nicht in seinen direkten Arbeitsbereich fallen.Der Schöffenrat hat das Recht, den Arbeitsnehmer je nach den Erfordernissen der Verwaltung in jeder Abteilung der Stadt Grevenmacher einzusetzen.Während der Freibadsaison sind die täglichen und wöchentlichen Arbeitszeiten mittels eines vom Schöffenkollegium aufgestellten Dienstplans geregelt. Des Weiteren wird Urlaubsanträgen während der Freibadsaison nur in Ausnahmefällen stattgegeben.Außerhalb der Freibadsaison sind die Arbeitszeiten von 7.00 Uhr bis 12.00 Uhr und von 13.00 Uhr bis 16.00 Uhr.Beizufügende Unterlagen:–      Bewerbungsschreiben;–      Ausführlicher Lebenslauf mit Foto;–      Kopie des CATP / DAP- Diploms / des Meisterbriefes;–      Geburtsurkunde (nicht älter als 2 Monate);–      Auszug aus dem Strafregister (nicht älter als 2 Monate)–      Passfoto–      Kopie eines Ausweisdokumentes;–      Kopie des Führerscheins.Unvollständige Bewerbungen werden nicht berücksichtigt Beschäftigungsbedingungen und Vergütung:Spätestens bei Dienstantritt muss der Kandidat die für die Ausübung seines Amtes erforderliche körperliche Eignung nachweisen. Die körperliche Eignung wird vom Arbeitsarzt auf Antrag der Gemeindeverwaltung festgestellt.Die Feststellung der körperlichen Untauglichkeit durch den Arbeitsarzt, auch nachdem der betreffende Arbeitnehmer seine Arbeit aufgenommen hat, führt zur Auflösung des Arbeitsvertrags.Die Einstellung erfolgt durch Unterzeichnung eines unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrages nach den Bestimmungen des Kollektivvertrages der Stadt Grevenmacher.Die ersten drei Monate ab dem Datum des Dienstantritts gelten als Probezeit.Der Arbeitnehmer wird in die ME-Laufbahn (Gehaltsgruppen 6, 7 und 8) des Kollektivvertrags für die Angestellten der Stadt Grevenmacher eingestuft.Die ersten zwei Jahre ab dem Datum der Einstellung sind grundsätzlich eine Einarbeitungszeit und werden auf der Grundlage der ersten Stufe der ME-Laufbahn (147 Indexpunkte – 3.684,87.-€, bezahlt).Nach einer positiven Beurteilung am Ende der Einarbeitungszeit wird die endgültige Laufbahn des Beschäftigten unter Berücksichtigung der Vordienstzeit festgelegt.Je nach Berufserfahrung kann der Schöffenrat beschließen, die Einarbeitungszeit zu verkürzen oder ganz darauf zu verzichten.Der Arbeitnehmer hat Anspruch auf eine Kompensationsprämie (13 Indexpunkte – 325,87.-€), eine Essenszulage (11 Indexpunkte – 275,74.-€) und Kleidergeld (2 Indexpunkte – 50,13.-€). Gegebenenfalls erhält der Arbeitnehmer eine Familienzulage von 29 Indexpunkten – 726,95.-€.Das Gehalt wird zu Beginn des Folgemonats gezahlt, für den das Gehalt fällig ist, spätestens jedoch am 5. des Monats.Eine Jahresendzulage wird zusammen mit dem Dezembergehalt gezahlt.Verschiedenes:Der Arbeitnehmer wird bei der Caisse Nationale de Santé und der Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Pension angemeldet.Die Kandidaten werden gebeten Ihre Bewerbung bis spätestens Dienstag, den 1. Dezember 2026 über die Plattform „Skeeled“ (www.grevenmacher.lu – Veröffentlichungen – Jobs) einzureichen. Die Personalabteilung steht Ihnen für weitere Auskünfte gerne zur Verfügung:Tel.: 75 03 11 -2021 (Frau Steffen) oder -2031 (Herr Lanser)E-Mail: personnel@grevenmacher.lu

title: Devops Engineer (m/f)
description: Devops Engineerlocations Luxembourg (Siège Lux House)time type Full timejob requisition id REQ-10123721Your role & work environmentAs a DevOps Engineer, you contribute to the automation, standardization and reliability of infrastructure and application platforms. You work on critical Linux environments, Cloud initiatives and the automation of operations while ensuring compliance with the bank's security and operational standards.You collaborate closely with Development, Security and Infrastructure teams and contribute to continuous improvement, technical documentation and knowledge sharing.Your key responsibilitiesInfrastructure, Cloud & reliability• Administer and maintain Linux servers, IPC platforms and related infrastructure.• Deploy and operate Cloud infrastructure, primarily on Microsoft Azure.• Ensure platform availability, performance and security, and participate in incident, problem and change management activities.Automation & DevOps• Develop and maintain automation solutions using Ansible, Python and Shell scripting.• Industrialize deployment and configuration processes using Infrastructure as Code principles.• Manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Azure DevOps and Jenkins.Security & continuous improvement• Administer SSL/TLS certificates and certificate auto-renewal solutions.• Work with certificate management automation tools, Vault and Azure Key Vault and apply Linux security best practices.• Maintain technical documentation, promote knowledge sharing and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.We look forA colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.As a DevOps Engineer you will also need:• 3 to 5 years of experience in a DevOps, SRE or Infrastructure role.• Strong Linux administration skills, including troubleshooting and log analysis.• Proven experience with Ansible, Python and Bash/Shell scripting.• Good understanding of Cloud environments, particularly Microsoft Azure.• Experience with Git, GitHub or Azure DevOps and CI/CD environments.• Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes.• Knowledge of SSL/TLS certificate management, Vault or Azure Key Vault and Linux security best practices.• Knowledge of monitoring solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK/Elastic Stack or Splunk.• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.• Ability to work effectively in a team with a continuous improvement mindset.• Professional proficiency in English.• Interest in AI technologies and their application within the banking sector.Nice to have:• Experience in a banking or financial environment.• Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes or Podman.• Azure, Red Hat or Ansible certifications.• Experience with ServiceNow, GitHub Enterprise and ITSM tools.We redefine banking. What about you?There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centred around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that !

title: Directeur Général Adjoint (h/f/d)
description: Directeur Général Adjoint (H/F/D) CDI - Temps plein - Luxembourg (Strassen) Réf. : AeS/DGA Rejoignez l'Agence eSanté L'Agence eSanté, agence nationale des informations partagées dans le domaine de la santé, joue un rôle central dans la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois. Elle développe et opère les services qui permettent aux patients et aux professionnels de santé d'échanger et de partager les données de santé en toute sécurité : dossier de soins partagé, réseau sécurisé HealthNet, annuaires nationaux des patients et des professionnels, carnet de vaccination électronique, messagerie sécurisée, échanges transfrontaliers de données de santé, entre autres. Les années à venir sont décisives : la mise en oeuvre du règlement européen sur l'Espace européen des données de santé (EHDS) et le développement de la nouvelle génération du dossier de soins partagé s'accompagnent d'une forte croissance de l'Agence et de ses effectifs. L'Agence eSanté recrute un(e) Directeur Général Adjoint. Directement rattaché(e) au Directeur Général et membre du Comité de Direction, vous contribuez au pilotage et au développement de l'Agence. Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de la Direction, les différentes fonctions de l'Agence et ses instances de gouvernance, notamment le Président du Conseil de gérance. Votre mission En tant que Directeur Général Adjoint, vous accompagnez le Directeur Général dans la direction, le pilotage et le développement de l'Agence et contribuez à la mise en oeuvre de ses orientations stratégiques. Membre du Comité de Direction, vous participez à la gouvernance de l'Agence, préparez les décisions et arbitrages et accompagnez les transformations organisationnelles nécessaires à son développement. Vous pilotez les fonctions support de l'Agence (ressources humaines, finances, secrétariat, qualité et organisation, juridique, conformité, marchés publics, formation et formation continue, contrats ainsi que communication), veillez à la performance et à la cohérence des dispositifs transverses et représentez l'Agence dans le cadre des délégations qui vous sont confiées. Vos principales responsabilités • Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre des orientations stratégiques et au développement de l'Agence, en accompagnant le Directeur Général dans la définition des priorités et leur déclinaison opérationnelle, • Participer à la gouvernance de l'Agence, conseiller le Directeur Général, préparer les décisions et arbitrages soumis aux instances compétentes et veiller au suivi de leur mise en oeuvre, • Assurer le secrétariat du Conseil de gérance et de l'Assemblée générale : préparation des séances et des dossiers, rédaction des procès-verbaux et relevés de décisions, suivi de l'exécution des décisions, • Superviser les programmes et projets de transformation organisationnelle conduits pour le compte du Comité de Direction, en veillant à leur avancement, à leurs moyens et à la préparation des décisions nécessaires, • Piloter les fonctions placées sous votre responsabilité, garantir la cohérence de leurs activités et veiller à la disponibilité et à l'utilisation optimale des ressources de l'Agence, • Contribuer aux orientations budgétaires et financières et piloter la préparation, l'exécution et le suivi budgétaire annuel et pluriannuel dans le cadre des responsabilités déléguées, • Veiller à la cohérence des politiques, processus et dispositifs de gouvernance interne et superviser les dispositifs de contrôle et de conformité relevant de votre périmètre, dans le respect des responsabilités et de l'indépendance des fonctions compétentes, • Piloter la performance et la maîtrise des risques relevant de votre périmètre, en coordonnant les démarches d'audit, de certification et d'amélioration continue avec les fonctions compétentes, • Favoriser la coopération entre les fonctions et contribuer, aux côtés du Directeur Général, à la préparation et à la conduite du dialogue social, • Manager et développer les responsables placés sous votre autorité, renforcer leurs compétences managériales et promouvoir une culture de responsabilité, de coopération et de remontée précoce des difficultés, • Représenter l'Agence auprès des autorités et partenaires institutionnels dans le cadre de vos délégations et assurer la suppléance du Directeur Général conformément aux dispositions applicables. Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation supérieure de niveau Master ou équivalent en management, administration publique, économie, gestion, finances, droit, politiques publiques, ingénierie, gouvernance des organisations ou dans un domaine équivalent. Vous justifiez : • d'au moins 10 années d'expérience dans des fonctions de direction, de management senior ou de pilotage de fonctions support, • d'une expérience confirmée dans le management de managers et le pilotage de plusieurs fonctions support ou domaines de responsabilité transverses, • d'une expérience solide en gouvernance organisationnelle, en conseil à une Direction Générale et en préparation de décisions stratégiques, • d'une expérience dans le pilotage budgétaire et financier, la conduite de transformations organisationnelles et les relations avec des autorités ou partenaires institutionnels. Une expérience dans le secteur public, parapublic, de la santé ou dans un environnement fortement réglementé constitue un atout. Une bonne connaissance du secteur de la santé, de ses acteurs et de son environnement institutionnel et réglementaire, ou la capacité à l'acquérir rapidement, constitue également un atout. Compétences recherchées • Solide maîtrise des principes de gouvernance, des processus décisionnels et du pilotage stratégique d'une organisation, • Expérience confirmée dans la direction et la coordination de fonctions pluridisciplinaires et dans la gestion des ressources humaines, financières et organisationnelles, • Bonne maîtrise de la gestion budgétaire et financière, des marchés publics nationaux et européens, de la gestion contractuelle et des enjeux juridiques et réglementaires, • Maîtrise des dispositifs de pilotage de la performance, de contrôle interne, de gestion des risques et de conformité, • Capacité à conduire des transformations organisationnelles, à faire évoluer les processus et à accompagner le changement, • Leadership confirmé dans le management de managers, le développement des compétences et la mobilisation d'équipes pluridisciplinaires, • Bonne compréhension des environnements institutionnels et capacité à conseiller la Direction Générale, à préparer des arbitrages complexes et à représenter l'organisation auprès d'interlocuteurs de haut niveau, • Pratique avancée des outils numériques et de l'IA générative pour accroître votre efficacité et celle de vos équipes, dans le respect des exigences de sécurité et de confidentialité. Qualités personnelles • Leadership, sens des responsabilités et capacité à fédérer autour d'objectifs communs, • Vision stratégique, esprit d'analyse et capacité à prendre du recul, • Courage décisionnel, indépendance de jugement et capacité à assumer les arbitrages, • Diplomatie, sens de l'écoute et capacité à développer des relations de confiance, • Pragmatisme, orientation résultats et capacité à agir dans des situations complexes ou sensibles, • Exemplarité, intégrité, loyauté institutionnelle et engagement au service de l'intérêt général. Langues • Luxembourgeois : niveau C1 minimum, • Français : niveau C1 minimum, • Anglais : niveau C1 minimum, • Allemand : niveau B1 minimum. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Rejoindre l'Agence eSanté, c'est contribuer à la transformation numérique du système de santé luxembourgeois et participer au développement d'une organisation investie d'une mission d'intérêt général. title: Group Chief Compliance Officer (m/f)
description: Group Chief Compliance OfficerRole OverviewThe Group Chief Compliance Officer (GCCO) is responsible for leading and coordinating the compliance program across the ONE Group, ensuring the effective management of regulatory, compliance, conduct, and governance risks across all group entities.The GCCO provides operational leadership to the Group Compliance Function, oversees the implementation of a consistent and risk-based compliance framework, and drives the continued development of an integrated compliance operating model across Luxembourg, the UK, Ireland, and the Porto Global Operations Centre.The role also serves as Chair of the Group Compliance Committee and acts as the principal representative of the compliance function across the ONE Group. Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Group Compliance Leadership • Lead, manage, develop, and mentor the Group Compliance Function across all jurisdictions instilling a group approach to compliance. • Create a high-performing and collaborative compliance culture across Luxembourg, Ireland, the UK, and Porto. • Serve as the primary representative of the compliance function within the ONE Group. 2. Group Compliance Program • Design, implement, and continuously enhance the Group Compliance Program. • Establish common standards, policies, procedures, methodologies, and reporting frameworks across all entities. • Drive initiatives that improve effectiveness, scalability, efficiency, and consistency of compliance activities throughout the Group.3. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight • Oversee compliance with applicable regulatory requirements across all Group entities. • Coordinate regulatory interactions, inspections, remediation activities, and regulatory change management processes. • Provide strategic advice to senior management and governing bodies on compliance risks and regulatory developments. 4. Operational Leadership • Coordinate and oversee all operational aspects of compliance service delivery across the Group achieving optimal effectiveness and efficiency by centralising compliance tasks at the group level under a group approach and common standards. • Manage resource allocation, prioritisation of work, capacity planning, and coordination of compliance activities between teams. • Oversee compliance-related operational processes from onboarding and implementation through ongoing servicing and oversight. 5. Governance & Risk Management • Lead the Group Compliance Committee and contribute to broader governance forums. • Ensure effective coordination with Legal, Risk, AML/CFT, Internal Audit, and business functions. • Support the Group's three-lines-of-defence framework and strengthen compliance risk management practices across the organisation. The Group Compliance Function is intended to coordinate compliance risk oversight, support regulatory change implementation, and promote a culture of compliance and integrity throughout the Group. Profile & Experience • Significant experience in a senior compliance leadership role within a regulated financial services, ManCo, AIFM, PSF, or professional services environment. • Strong understanding of Luxembourg and European regulatory frameworks, governance, risk management, and compliance best practices. • Proven experience leading and developing multi-jurisdictional compliance teams. • Demonstrated ability to build and scale compliance frameworks and operating models. • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, executive committees, and senior stakeholders. • Fluency in English; additional European languages are advantageous. Key Attributes • Strong organisational, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. • Excellent communication and commercial awareness. • High-quality delivery mindset. • Innovative and change management mindset.

title: Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg) (m/f)
description: Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg)Role OverviewAs Manager, Client Corporate Governance (Luxembourg), you will be accountable for a team of governance professionals and a defined portfolio of clients. Reporting to the Jurisdiction Lead, you will combine hands-on client leadership with people management, portfolio oversight, commercial awareness and technical governance expertise.This is a core management role and an important development step towards broader jurisdictional leadership. You will make decisions within your portfolio, coach and develop team members, lead key client relationships, guide complex governance matters and contribute to the continued development of how ONE delivers governance services.At ONE, we believe talented people do their best work when given trust, autonomy and the freedom to make a genuine impact. We are looking for people who combine strong technical.Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities 1. Team Leadership & People Development • Lead, organise and develop a team of governance professionals responsible for an allocated client portfolio. • Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and create an environment in which team members are trusted, supported and accountable. • Coach and develop team members, building technical capability, professional judgement and confidence. • Create meaningful opportunities for colleagues to take on increasing responsibility and progress their careers. • Support engagement, retention and succession planning within the team. • Plan and allocate work effectively across the team, balancing client priorities, capacity and development opportunities. 2. Portfolio Delivery & Governance Leadership • Own the day-to-day delivery of Company Secretarial, Corporate Governance and Domiciliation Services across the allocated client portfolio, including accountability for technical quality, appropriate review and escalation. • Maintain high standards of quality, consistency and service across board support, minutes, resolutions, statutory maintenance and governance reporting. • Lead complex transactions, restructurings, incorporations, liquidations and governance projects within the portfolio. • Apply ONE governance standards and quality controls consistently across the team. • Use sound judgement to make portfolio decisions and provide technical guidance on complex governance matters, acting as a point of escalation for the team and ensuring material or higher-risk matters are escalated appropriately. 3. Client Relationship Management • Lead relationships with clients, boards and senior stakeholders across a varied portfolio of financial services and investment fund structures. • Build trusted relationships with AIFMs, management companies, banks, investment managers, sponsors, institutional investors and professional advisers, as relevant to the portfolio. • Provide practical governance advice and lead client service discussions. • Take ownership of complex client requirements and ensure agreed actions are delivered. • Support client retention and appropriate growth opportunities through high-quality service and strong relationships. 4. Risk, Compliance & Professional Standards • Maintain effective oversight of governance-related risks and controls across the portfolio. • Ensure governance activities are delivered in accordance with applicable requirements, constitutional documents and internal policies. • Stay abreast of regulatory and market developments and translate relevant changes into practical team actions. • Promote sound governance, professional conduct and ethical decision-making across the team. 5. Continuous Improvement & Change • Identify and implement practical improvements to governance delivery and the ONE operating model. • Lead standardisation, automation and efficiency initiatives within the team and portfolio. • Drive the responsible adoption and effective use of technology and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, efficiency and client outcomes, ensuring agreed tools and processes are embedded across the team. • Contribute operational insight to governance products, processes and service development. • Participate in jurisdictional and cross-business initiatives. 6. Portfolio & Commercial Management • Own portfolio planning, utilisation, time recording, recoverability, work in progress and invoicing discipline, taking timely action where performance falls outside expectations. • Provide relevant forecasting and portfolio information to the Jurisdiction Lead. • Contribute technical and delivery input to proposals, DDQs, client pitches, pricing reviews and scope discussions. • Identify and actively pursue opportunities to deepen client relationships and broaden appropriate services. • Manage the portfolio with appropriate attention to scope, efficiency, recoverability and sustainable service delivery, identifying and addressing scope creep, under-pricing and other issues affecting client economics. 7. Client Governance & Internal Collaboration • Attend board meetings and contribute independent judgement, challenge and governance expertise. • Support effective board decision-making, oversight and governance practices across assigned structures. • Build credibility as a trusted governance contact for boards and senior stakeholders. • Work closely with the Jurisdiction Lead and colleagues across Compliance, Risk, Finance, Technology and other service teams. • Support new business approvals, client onboarding and governance reviews for the portfolio. • Represent ONE professionally with clients, boards, advisers and external stakeholders. Profile & Experience • Degree educated with a strong academic background in law, corporate governance, business administration, corporate services or a related discipline. • Professional qualification in Corporate Governance, Company Secretarial Practice, Law, Compliance or similar highly desirable. • +7 years' relevant experience within company secretarial, governance, fund administration, fiduciary services or a related governance environment. • Demonstrable experience managing complex Luxembourg fund, corporate or regulated financial services structures. • Strong understanding of Luxembourg corporate law, governance requirements and regulated environments. • Experience across a broad range of financial services clients or structures, which may include UCITS, alternative investment funds, management companies, banks, investment managers and related corporate entities. • Demonstrable experience leading, supervising and developing governance professionals. • Experience owning a portfolio of clients and managing relationships with boards and senior stakeholders. • Experience improving delivery quality, standardising processes and implementing operational change. • Excellent communication skills and fluent written and spoken English. Additional European languages advantageous. Key Attributes • Strong commercial awareness and understanding of professional services delivery models. • Enjoy helping people and teams succeed. • Prefer creating solutions rather than simply following established processes. • Are comfortable making decisions and taking ownership. • Enjoy engaging with clients, boards and senior stakeholders. • Balance commercial awareness with sound judgement and governance integrity. • Are energised by growth, change and continuous improvement. • Believe technology should enhance, rather than replace, professional expertise.

title: RESEARCHER ECO-HYDROLOGIST - CRITICAL ZONE (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: Permanent contract | BelvauxAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?This position is for a scientist to contribute to the core mission of the Catchment and Eco-hydrology group within the Environmental Modelling and Sensing unit. Research will investigate processes controlling behavior of Earth's Critical Zone, with an emphasis on understanding dependencies and feedbacks between the hydrologic cycle and ecosystems. We seek a scientist dedicated to integrating novel empirical observations and theory to answer questions motivated by pressing societal needs related to natural resources, and relevant to both the global scientific community and applied practitioners who manage those natural resources. The successful candidate will be a key member of an interdisciplinary and collaborative research group. The successful candidate is expected to develop an internationally recognized research program in ecohydrology, specifically in one of the following research areas:1. Tracers of eco-hydrologic processes. Research developing and applying innovative tracer approaches to understand water dynamics and associated biogeochemical processes across the soil–plant–atmosphere continuum. Building on existing strengths and infrastructure in the group, particular interest lies in stable isotope approaches that integrate environmental and eco-hydrological information using hydrological, plant physiological, or biogeochemical measurements.2. Small-catchment eco-hydrology. Research investigating interactions among vegetation, water dynamics, and biogeochemical processes, especially in forested headwater catchments. Particular interests include plant and ecosystem responses to hydrological extremes such as droughts and floods; thresholds and tipping points in vegetation and catchment functioning; and ecohydrological controls on the cycling and transport of carbon, plant nutrients, and pollutants.  Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Experience and kills• PhD in Hydrology, Eco-hydrology, Isotope Biogeochemistry, Earth System Science, Environmental Science, or a related discipline• Post-doctoral research experience commensurate with an established researcher• Demonstrated ability to connect a research program with external funding sources, including competitive grants and public and private partnerships• Skill in both basic and applied science, interdisciplinary teams, and entrepreneurial development of research programs Language skills• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Skills in French, German, or Luxembourgish are assets. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchersApply onlineYour application must include:• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience• A scientific CV with contact details• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)• Contact details of 2 referencesPlease apply ONLINE formally through the HR system.
