title: Executive Director/Directeur Général (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Executive Director / Directeur Général (m/f/x)Friendship Luxembourg asbl LuxembourgAbout Friendship LuxembourgFounded in 2006, Friendship Luxembourg is part of the international Friendship network and supports the work of Friendship in Bangladesh, where the organisation works with some of the country's most remote and vulnerable communities.Friendship delivers programmes across healthcare, education, economic development, humanitarian assistance and climate resilience, and is an internationally recognised, award- winning organisation, most recently named the 2025 Earthshot Prize winner in the “Fix Our Climate” category.As Friendship Luxembourg continues to grow and evolve, we are looking for an Executive Director to lead its Luxembourg operations and support the organisation's continued development.The RoleReporting to the Board of Directors and working closely with the Chair and other Board members, the Executive Director will have overall responsibility for the day-to-day management of Friendship Luxembourg and its team of six persons.This is a broad, hands-on leadership role combining operational management, team leadership, stakeholder engagement, fundraising and organisational development. The successful candidate will play a central role in ensuring that Friendship Luxembourg operates effectively, develops strong relationships with its partners and donors, and continues to strengthen its contribution to the wider Friendship network.Key Responsibilities• Lead and support the Friendship Luxembourg team, setting clear priorities and fostering an effective and collaborative working environment.• Manage the organisation's activities and continued development, ensuring effective implementation of Board decisions and agreed priorities.• Strengthen fundraising and donor engagement, while identifying new funding sources and partnership opportunities.• Oversee financial and organisational management, including budgeting, financial monitoring, resource planning and internal processes.• Work closely with the Board of Directors, providing clear reporting, ensuring effective information flow and supporting implementation of Board decisions.• Develop and maintain key external relationships with public authorities, institutional partners, foundations, NGOs, donors and other stakeholders.• Coordinate with Friendship Bangladesh and the wider Friendship network, supporting effective collaboration across the organisation.• Represent Friendship Luxembourg externally, contributing to its visibility, credibility and presence within Luxembourg's development and humanitarian ecosystem.Candidate ProfileWe are looking for an experienced and credible leader who combines sound judgement, strong interpersonal skills and a pragmatic, hands-on approach.The ideal candidate will bring:• Relevant senior management or leadership experience, gained within an NGO, foundation, international organisation or the private sector.• Proven people-management skills and experience leading a professional team.• Experience in fundraising, donor relations, stakeholder management and/or partnership development.• Strong financial, organisational and project-management capabilities.• The ability to work effectively with a Board of Directors and senior external stakeholders.• A good understanding of the Luxembourg institutional and non-profit environment.• Excellent communication, relationship-building and organisational skills.• A high degree of integrity, autonomy, judgement and commitment to Friendship's mission.• Fluency in English and French is essential. Luxembourgish would be an advantage.Other languages would also be valuable.• You must already have the legal right to work in Luxembourg and you must be able to maintain a regular on-site presence in Luxembourg.What We OfferThis is an opportunity to take on a highly visible and varied leadership role within a committed, international and mission-driven organisation.The General Manager will have the opportunity to contribute directly to the future development of Friendship Luxembourg — strengthening the organisation, developing its funding and partnerships, supporting its team and helping increase the impact of Friendship's work with vulnerable communities.Location: LuxembourgPosition: Full-timeReporting to: Board of DirectorsApplication ProcedurePlease submit your application to Friendship using the following email address only: jobs@friendship.lu. Applications to any other email address will not be considered. Your application must include your CV and a separate motivation letter. Applications may be submitted in French or English.Please note that AI-assisted tools may be used to support the analysis of your application.Deadline for submission is 4 December 2026, but early application is encouraged. You can expect to be contacted by 22 December 2026. First interviews are expected to take place during the second half of December and early January. We hope to be able to reply to all applications, however if you have not received a response from us by 23 December 2026, you may consider that your application does not meet the required criteria for this position.Études: Master (Bac+5)Métier / domaine de formation:Expérience dans une ONG ou fondation et une bonne compréhension de l'environnement institutionnel et des ONG au Luxembourg. Expérience requise: 10 années

title: Business Intelligence Engineer, OTS COST, Ops Tech Solutions Delivery (m/f)
description: Business Intelligence Engineer, OTS COST, Ops Tech Solutions DeliveryJob ID: 10591703 | Amazon EU SarlDescriptionThe COST (Cost Optimization, Strategy, and Technology) team within Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) Delivery is seeking a Business Intelligence Engineer to build and own the data products behind its cost work. The COST team delivers cost visibility, savings governance, and free cash flow improvement across a global RME and IT Operations cost base.Within COST, our team finds savings opportunities, checks whether savings are real, and gives leaders the cost reporting and comparisons they use to make decisions.You will work with program managers and leaders who use your work to make cost decisions. You take data from our shared data platform and turn it into dashboards, datasets and analysis that people can trust. We use generative AI day to day, alongside SQL and dashboards.Key job responsibilities- Build and own dashboards, datasets and reporting that leaders use to understand and manage cost- Analyze spend data to find trends, anomalies and savings opportunities, and explain what you find to non-technical audiences- Build the data and checks that show whether savings have actually been delivered- Automate the team's own manual work, including with generative AI tools, so program managers spend less time on reporting- Work to the team's priorities, and say early when you think a different piece of work would matter more- Validate your outputs against source data and business logic, and fix issues at the cause- Document your products so others on the team can run them- Work with engineering partners on data sources and data qualityA day in the lifeNo two days are the same. You might check a data refresh, work with a program manager on whether a spend change is a real cost signal, build a new view for a leadership review, or work through a data issue with an engineering partner. Travel up to 10%.About the teamWe are a small team of program managers and BI, based in Europe and part of OTS Delivery. We work closely with the team that owns our data platform and delivers technical programs, and we document our work so anyone on the team can pick it up.Basic Qualifications- Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.- Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools- Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)- Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)- Experience with SQL- Experience building and maintaining basic data artifacts (e.g., ETL, data models, queries)Preferred Qualifications- Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree- Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design- Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis- Knowledge of how to improve code quality and optimizes BI processes (e.g. speed, cost, reliability)- Experience working with finance or spend data, such as purchase orders, general ledger or cost center data- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional settingAmazon is an equal opportunities employer. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:Job Description: Post-Quantum Cryptography EngineerPosition:  Post-Quantum Cryptography EngineerLocation:  Esch-sur-Alzette, LuxembourgStart Date:  ImmediateType:  Full-timeSalary:  Competitive, based on qualifications and experienceCompany OverviewLuxQuantum is a deep-tech startup developing quantum-safe security solutions. Our mission is to enable the transition to quantum-safe communications by integrating classical cryptography, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), and Quantum Key Distribution (QKD).Our current R&D efforts focus on the development of hybrid quantum security technologies, including cryptographic key combination, key management, and interoperability across heterogeneous communication infrastructures.We are looking for a motivated Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer to join our growing team and contribute to the design, implementation, and validation of cryptographic components for hybrid quantum-safe communication systems.Role OverviewAs a Post-Quantum Cryptography Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of hybrid quantum-safe communication solutions. The role focuses on the design, implementation, and evaluation of PQC mechanisms within hybrid PQC–QKD security architectures.You will work closely with researchers and engineers to develop software modules, implement and evaluate cryptographic algorithms, and contribute to integrating PQC technologies with QKD and existing cryptographic systems, with a focus on security, interoperability, and real-world integration.Key Responsibilities• Design and implement software components for post-quantum cryptographic systems.• Integrate PQC algorithms into hybrid PQC–QKD security architectures.• Evaluate PQC algorithms, libraries and implementations for security, performance and integration suitability.• Contribute to the development of secure key establishment and hybrid cryptographic protocols, including hybrid key combination and key management mechanisms.• Collaborate with system engineers to integrate PQC components with QKD technologies and interoperability layers.• Perform functional, performance, security and interoperability testing of cryptographic implementations.• Prepare technical documentation and contribute to project deliverables and research reports.• Monitor developments in PQC standardization and emerging cryptographic research to ensure alignment with relevant standards and technological advances.Required Qualifications• Strong foundation in applied cryptography, with a solid understanding of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC).• MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Cryptography, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.• Hands-on experience implementing, integrating or evaluating cryptographic algorithms and software libraries, preferably including PQC.• Familiarity with cryptographic protocols and secure key exchange mechanisms.• Strong programming skills in C/C++ or Rust, with Python experience considered an advantage.• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.• Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.• Fluency in written and spoken English.Preferred Qualifications• Experience with PQC libraries, frameworks or NIST-standardised post-quantum algorithms.• Knowledge of network security protocols and key management systems.• Familiarity with quantum communication systems or QKD concepts• Experience working in research or R&D environments• Knowledge of hybrid cryptographic architectures, crypto-agility and interoperability between classical and post-quantum security technologies.What We Offer• Opportunity to work on challenging R&D projects at the intersection of post-quantum cryptography, quantum communications and cybersecurity.• An active role in technical development and engineering decisions within a growing deep-tech startup.• Collaboration with academic and research partners in the quantum technology ecosystem.• Direct contribution to the development of practical and interoperable quantum-safe communication technologies.How to ApplyIf you are passionate about cryptography and quantum-safe communications, we encourage you to apply.Please send your CV and a short cover letter explaining your interest in Post-QuantumCryptography and quantum cybersecurity to:  contact@luxquantum.luJoin us in building the future of quantum-safe communications.Études:  Master (Bac+5)

title: Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in Anatomy (m/f)
description: Associate Professor or Assistant Professor in Anatomy(Valid from 06/11/2026 to 23/04/2027) Language: English (UK)Location Esch-sur-AlzetteCountry: Luxembourg Organisation data: Department of Health, Medicine and Life SciencesJob Number: UOL08595Contract Type: Professorial - PermanentSchedule Type: Full TimeWork Hours 40.0 Hours per WeekExpected Start Date: 01/10/2027 Job (internal): Assistant ProfessorJob Level: MonolevelRole Type: Open PositionExpertise: ProfessorsFunctions: Associate / Assistant Professor Position: 50024306 About usThe University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in. Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives. Your roleThe successful candidate will coordinate anatomy teaching within the University's Bachelor of Medicine programme and contribute to teaching in other health and life sciences programmes. Working closely with colleagues across the University, they will contribute to an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students and to the continued development of the University's anatomy curriculum.The position offers a unique opportunity to collaborate with local and international partners in developing and implementing innovative, state-of-the-art approaches to anatomy education. These may include virtual dissection tools, 3D anatomical models, such as Anatomage® and virtual anatomy platforms, and other digital learning resources, to provide students with comprehensive and engaging learning opportunities.The recruited candidate will have access to state-of-the-art infrastructures within the university, including a simulation unit equipped with an anatomy suite. They will also be responsible for coordinating dissection courses and practical anatomy sessions, including the procurement of virtual tools and teaching specimens, in collaboration with medical institutions and partner universities. Research portfolio: the candidate has an internationally recognised research profile and is expected to develop ambitious research activities in line with the strategic priorities of the university. The latter include cancer research, neurosciences, data-driven health sciences, digital biology, and medicine.The ideal candidate has a medical background with relevant clinical experience and a commitment to integrating clinical perspectives and applications into anatomy education to enhance the practical, real world application aspect of anatomy courses. The possibility of a clinical activity will be decided on a case-by-case decision. Non-medical profiles with a strong affinity and expertise in anatomy will be considered as well. For further information about the role, please contact: Prof. Pascal Stammet, Study Programme Director of the Bachelor of Medicine, Email: pascal.stammet@uni.luYour profile• PhD in a medicine related field and/or MD diploma• Experience in the teaching of human anatomy, ideally in a variety of curricula in medicine, life sciences and for health care professions at undergraduate and graduate levels• Commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching that integrates anatomy with histology and embryology• Experience or familiarity with modern teaching tools such as virtual dissection platforms, 3D modelling, and other digital resources• Solid track record in clinical and/or biomedical research within a related domain• Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with the ability to build and foster academic partnerships, particularly with existing collaborators at partner universities and institutions• Physician candidates should have clinical/medical activity Language requirements:The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must have an excellent command of English and either French or German. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end. We offer• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs How to applyApplications should contain:• Cover letter, to be addressed to to Serge Haan, Head of DHML• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks.• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications, projects, teaching expertise and accomplishments in knowledge transfer relevant to this role (1-3 pages).• Statement of planned research, teaching and other activities at the University of Luxembourg (1–3 pages).• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught.• Names, contact information and current position of 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you.We encourage early application. Applications are only accepted online through the HR system. The position will be unposted on 06.01.2027, after which no further applications can be submitted. Company;• An AIFM;• A law firm; or• A specialised investment fund services provider.• Proven experience in UCITS prospectus drafting, CSSF approval processes and Luxembourg fund lifecycle events is quality.• Ability to work autonomously whilst collaborating effectively with internal and external stakeholders.Languages:• Fluent English (written and spoken).• Fluent French (written and spoken).• description: Chargé.e de mission collecte de fonds (m/f/x) CDI 80% ou 100 %Depuis près de 60 ans, la Fondation Lëtzebuerger Kannerduerf agit pour offrir aux enfants, aux jeunes et aux familles, l'accompagnement dont ils ont besoin pour construire leur avenir.Afin de renforcer notre équipe Relation partenaires et Donateurs, nous recherchons un·e Chargé·e de mission de collecte de fonds (m/f/x) motivé·e par les relations humaines, le développement de partenariats et les enjeux sociétaux.CDI à 80 % ou 100 % Notre vision : Chaque enfant a besoin d'affection, de respect et d'attention pour pouvoir se développer et construire sa vie. Nous adhérons à la vision selon laquelle chaque enfant a le droit de grandir et se développer dans un environnement familial protecteur et respectueux de sa personne. Pour ce faire, vous mobilisez la générosité des particuliers, des entreprises, des associations, des fondations et des institutions.Vous participez au développement de nouveaux partenariats et au suivi des relations avec les donateurs.Vous jouez également un rôle important dans la gestion, l'analyse et l'évolution des outils qui soutiennent l'activité de collecte de fonds, notamment dans la perspective du renouvellement du CRM de la Fondation.Activités principales :En lien avec notre valeur « Responsabilité » :• Participer à la conception, à la coordination et à la mise en œuvre des campagnes de collecte de fonds et de fidélisation.• Contribuer au développement et au suivi des relations avec les donateurs, mécènes et partenaires.• Identifier et approcher de nouveaux partenaires relationnel ou les relations institutionnelles.• Vous maîtrisez les outils informatiques courants.• Vous possédez de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication.• Vous maîtrisez le luxembourgeois, le français, l'allemand et l'anglais.Compétences sociales et savoir-être :• Vous appréciez le contact humain et le développement de réseaux.• Vous faites preuve de rigueur, expérience dans l'utilisation et l'évolution d'un CRM (iRaiser, Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics ou équivalent).• Une bonne compréhension des enjeux liés à la qualité des données, au reporting et au suivi de la relation donateurs.• Une bonne connaissance du tissu économique, associatif, institutionnel et politique luxembourgeois.• Une forte affinité pour le secteur de l'Aide à l'Enfance et à la Famille, et un intérêt marqué pour les questions touchant au développement, à la protection et à l'accompagnement des enfants, des jeunes et des familles, ainsi qu'une profonde sensibilité aux enjeux sociétaux et humanitaires.Notre offre :• Une mission porteuse de sens au service des enfants, des jeunes et des familles.• Un environnement de travail multiculturel au sein d'une équipe engagée et collaborative.• Un poste varié alliant développement de partenariats, collecte de fonds et projets digitaux.• L'opportunité de contribuer à un projet structurant de renouvellement CRM.• Un CDI à 80 % conduire de la catégorie B (la possession du permis de conduire de la catégorie C et du Code 95 pourra constituer un avantage).• Avoir accompli une formation de base dans un service d'incendie ou :• Être responsable de l'entretien, de la maintenance et des dépannages de tous les bâtiments communaux ;• Contrôler et inspecter les équipements de sécurité (extincteurs, trousses de premiers secours, défibrillateurs, détecteurs de fumée) et observer les exercices d'évacuation ;• Vérifier les serrures, ainsi que les batteries et le bon fonctionnement des systèmes d'accès (p.ex. système « Salto ») ;• Relevé des compteurs d'énergies ;• Assurer le suivi et la surveillance des systèmes d'alarme anti-intrusion, des alarmes d'incendie (BMA) et des détecteurs de fumée;• Être disponible à intervenir en cas de déclenchement des systèmes d'alarme dans un des bâtiments communaux.• Organiser et accompagner les contrôles réglementaires de sécurité (p.ex. Luxcontrol pour portes motorisées et camion-grue) ainsi que les maintenances par des entreprises externes (détection incendie, éclairage de secours, chauffage, ramonage) ;• Contrôler et faire des dépannages et des petites réparations (sanitaire, chauffage, ventilation, serrurerie et menuiserie) ;• Gérer, commander, réceptionner et livrer le matériel de nettoyage pour les femmes de ménage et pour les WC publics ;• Demander les demandes d'offres de prix, établir des bons de commande, réceptionner les livraisons des différents services de la commune ;• Ranger, préparer et mettre en place les locaux et les salles pour les réunions, réceptions, mariages ainsi que pour les autres manifestations organisées par la commune ;• Installer les décorations pour les festivités communales (p.ex. salaire du mois de décembre.Divers :Le salarié sera affilié à la Caisse Nationale de Santé et à la Caisse Nationale d'Assurance Pension.Les dossiers de candidatures doivent parvenir au Collège des bourgmestre et échevins jusqu'au 1er décembre 2026 au plus tard via la plateforme « Skeeled » (www.grevenmacher.lu - publication – offres d'emploi).Les candidatures envoyées par courriel ou courrier postal ne seront pas prises en considération.Le service du personnel se tient à votre disposition pour toute information complémentaire :Tél. : 75 03 11 -2021 (Mme Steffen) ou -2031 (M. Lanser)Courriel : personnel@grevenmacher.lu

title: Temporary Executive Assistant -  Luxembourg
description:
As a (Temporary) Executive Assistant to the CFO, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to a senior executive. Acting as a key business partner, you will ensure the smooth management of the CFO's agenda, travel arrangements, communications, and day-to-day priorities, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and efficiency.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organization based in Luxembourg. The company offers a collaborative and professional environment where flexibility, trust, and high performance are valued. You will work closely with executive leadership and gain exposure to strategic business activities while supporting key operational processes.

Description

Executive & Administrative Support
  • Manage the CFO's complex agenda, meetings, appointments, and business commitments.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, meeting packs, and professional correspondence.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring urgent matters are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, and filing systems.
  • Anticipate administrative needs and provide proactive support on a daily basis.
Travel & Diary Management
  • Coordinate extensive domestic and international travel arrangements, including visas and logistics.
  • Organize flights, accommodation, transportation, and detailed itineraries.
  • Prepare travel documentation and monitor travel-related expenses and reimbursements.
  • Ensure scheduling conflicts are anticipated and resolved efficiently.
Stakeholder & Project Coordination
  • Serve as a key point of contact between the CFO and internal or external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, partners, and external contacts.
  • Monitor action points, track deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Support and coordinate business initiatives, projects, and executive-level meetings.
Office & Operational Support
  • Assist with budget monitoring and expense management across multiple cost centers.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Coordinate office-related activities and procurement when required.
  • Contribute to the smooth operation of daily business activities.
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
  • Proactive, autonomous, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Service-minded with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).

title: (Senior) Consultant - Cross Border Fund Distribution Services (m/f)
description: Job Title:  (Senior) Consultant - Cross Border Fund Distribution Services Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting Job Function:  Investment Management & Regulatory Level of Experience:  Experienced Contract Type:  Open-term Req ID:  14299 Job Description:  Your future teamOnsiteFull time Join Deloitte Luxembourg's Distribution Advisory Services team and support the cross-border registration and ongoing regulatory obligations of UCITS and AIFs. We help global asset managers, management companies and investment funds implement their international marketing plans through reliable operational delivery and practical regulatory guidance. Our work focuses on supporting regulatory requirements for marketing funds, rather than fund sales or capital-raising activities. As part of Deloitte luxembourg's Investment Management & Regulatory practice, you will combine project coordination, accurate document handling and client communication with applied regulatory analysis. At Consultant level, you will deliver defined activities with guidance. At Senior Consultant level, you will independently manage assigned projects or workstreams, resolve routine issues and support colleagues. Your level will be determined based on your experience and demonstrated capabilities. Key areas we cover:• Cross-border distribution operations: Coordinate registrations, notifications and post-registration updates through well-executed project management, accurate documentation and timely follow-up.• Cross-border distribution regulatory support: Identify, interpret and monitor the requirements applicable to the international marketing of investment funds.• Marketing compliance: Review promotional materials against applicable EU and local regulatory requirements.• Investment compliance: Assess asset eligibility and identify applicable investment restrictions. Support management companies with questions on investment compliance requirements and market practices.The advantages of joining us 1. Develop a fund-distribution specialismBuild practical knowledge of cross-border fund registration and regulation through client assignments, training and career development opportunities.2. Grow your client and project responsibilitiesWork with international asset managers and develop your ability to coordinate projects and take increasing ownership of client work.3. Combine technical knowledge with practical deliveryApply regulatory requirements to real client projects and work with tools and technology that support effective service delivery.4. Work in a collaborative environmentJoin a multicultural team where knowledge sharing and your contribution matter. The role is onsite and full time, with flexibility in working hours.5. Contribute beyond client workParticipate in sustainability initiatives and community service alongside your professional development.How you'll contribute to our success Coordinate Cross-Border Fund Registration & Post-Registration Projects:• Coordinate fund registrations and notifications across Europe and other markets, collecting and checking the required documentation and following up with clients and relevant stakeholders.• Support regulatory approval processes and ongoing post-registration obligations. Maintain accurate registration records and track deadlines, dependencies, document updates and outstanding actions.Develop & Apply Regulatory Expertise:• Develop your understanding of the local and international distribution requirements applicable to UCITS and AIFs, and apply that knowledge to client projects.• Monitor and analyse regulatory developments, assess their relevance to client activities and help prepare clear, practical guidance, seeking technical review where needed.Client Service Management:• Maintain regular client communication, provide accurate status updates and clarify the information and actions needed to progress projects.• Participate in client calls and meetings, taking the lead on assigned projects as your experience allows. Resolve routine delivery issues and escalate complex questions or risks promptly.Stakeholder Interaction:• Liaise with regulatory authorities, clients' legal advisers and colleagues to coordinate submissions, clarify requirements and keep projects moving.Your skills • A Master's degree in law, finance, economics, business administration or another relevant field.• Typically 2–4 years of relevant experience in the investment fund industry, asset management, fund distribution, regulatory advisory or a related consulting environment. Appointment at Consultant or Senior Consultant level will depend on your experience and demonstrated capabilities.• A working understanding of investment funds, including UCITS and AIFs, and an interest in developing cross-border distribution expertise.• Experience coordinating tasks or projects, handling documentation accurately and following up with clients or other stakeholders.• Fluency in written and spoken English, with clear professional drafting and communication skills.• Strong analytical ability, attention to detail and organisation, with the ability to prioritise work, meet deadlines and flag issues early.• A collaborative approach and willingness to take responsibility for assigned work. For Senior Consultant appointment, demonstrated ability to manage assigned projects or workstreams independently and handle routine client issues. Preferred capabilities• Direct experience with cross-border fund registrations, notifications or post-registration obligations, and familiarity with European or other local distribution requirements.• Professional French language skills.• For Senior Consultant candidates, experience sharing technical knowledge or supporting colleagues. Formal supervisory experience is not required for Consultant appointment.Interested? title: ORD & Sales Support Officer (m/f)
description: ORD & Sales Support OfficerDescription du posteL'ORD & Sales Support Officer est le référent opérationnel du logiciel ORD. Il assure la saisie, le contrôle et le suivi des commandes de biens financés, l'enregistrement des contrats et des actifs, puis la coordination de la livraison avec les fournisseurs et les clients. Il veille à la qualité des données, qui alimentent la facturation, la comptabilité et le reporting. Il pilote le déploiement d'ORD et porte ses évolutions. il suit les trois étapes du cycle Order – Register – Deliver, complétées par le déploiement du logiciel et des missions transverses. Le volet Sales Support couvre le support administratif commercial, la coordination des opérations et l'amélioration continue. Il assure le support administratif des activités commerciales de Van Mossel Autolease Luxembourg, en garantissant la fluidité des processus et la qualité du suivi des dossiers. Responsabilités et activités principales Gérer le flux des commandes et activer les contrats ORDCoordonner les livraisons et traiter les anomalies non conformitésParticiper au déploiement et à l'évolution du logiciel ORDAssurer la qualité et l'intégrité des données dans ORD Respecter les procédures internes, les contrôles de premier niveau et les exigences applicables Produire le suivi des dossiers en cours et des indicateurs d'activité Contribuer à la rédaction et à la mise à jour des modes opératoires Former et accompagner les nouveaux utilisateurs d'ORDAssurer le support administratif commercial Identifier les axes d'amélioration des processus commerciaux Garantir la qualité des données en relais de la discipline commercialeExpérience • 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en back ou middle office, idéalement en leasing, crédit-bail ou financement d'équipements. • Une connaissance du logiciel ORD est un plus. • Une expérience de mise en place ou d'évolution d'un logiciel de gestion est appréciée. • Une expérience en support commercial ou administration des ventes, idéalement dans le secteur automobile, est appréciée. Diplôme:Minimum requis éducation: Master (BAC+5)Compétences techniques • Connaissance des produits de leasing : crédit-bail, location financière, location longue durée. • Maîtrise des fondamentaux contractuels et comptables du leasing (loyers, valeur résiduelle, échéanciers). • Connaissance du leasing automobile et des démarches d'immatriculation au Luxembourg. • Aisance avec les outils informatiques de gestion ; Excel de niveau intermédiaire à avancé. • Connaissance des exigences réglementaires bancaires (KYC, LCB-FT, contrôle interne). Compétences comportementales • Esprit entrepreneurial : prendre des initiatives, construire et faire évoluer processus et outils. • Capacité à contribuer à la mise en place d'un nouveau logiciel et à accompagner le changement. • Rigueur et sens du détail dans la saisie et le contrôle des données. • Organisation et capacité à gérer un volume important de dossiers en parallèle. • Sens du service client, interne et externe. • Aisance relationnelle et capacité à relancer et coordonner plusieurs acteurs. • Réactivité et esprit de résolution de problèmes. • Esprit d'amélioration continue.Conditions du poste • Organisation du travail : horaires de bureau• Évolutions possibles : Senior ORD Officer, Team Leader Opérations Leasing, Key User ORD, fonctions de contrôle ou de gestion de projet.

description: Compensation & Benefits ManagerJob ID: 752735WDLuxembourgLine of Service Internal Firm ServicesIndustry/Sector Not ApplicableSpecialism IFS - Human Capital (HC)Management Level ManagerJob Description & SummaryMeet your future teamJoin our Human Capital team, working closely with HR professionals, business leaders and senior management to shape how reward strategies support employee engagement, retention and organisational success. You will collaborate with HR teams, business partners and external providers to deliver compensation and benefits programmes that are aligned with business needs, reward governance principles and regulatory requirements.What your role will look likeAs Compensation & Benefits Manager, you will take a leading role in Compensation & Benefits activities. As your scope grows, you will play an increasingly influential role in shaping PwC Luxembourg's reward strategy and employee experience.The skills you bring• Strong knowledge of compensation and benefits practices in Luxembourg.• Strong knowledge of HR policies and procedures.• Good knowledge of Luxembourg personal tax on employment incomes.• Basic knowledge on payroll processes.• English: C1 – full professional proficiency• French and/or German: considered an assetWays of working• Leadership & Coaching: Ability to manage, mentor, and develop team members to achieve excellence.• Organisational mastery: Strong planning and prioritisation skills to deliver complex projects on time.• Communication & influencing: Skilled in public speaking, presenting, and influencing stakeholders with clarity and impact. Ability to present complex information in a simple, compelling way that engages and influences diverse stakeholders.• Data & analytical thinking: Capacity to analyse data, anticipate trends, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.• Systems thinking & digital fluency: Ability to understand, use, and optimise HR systems and digital tools to improve data quality, process efficiency, user experience, and decision-making.• Proactive mindset: Anticipates challenges and proposes innovative solutions to continuously improve processes.• Project management: Proven ability to handle multiple, complex initiatives simultaneously under tight deadlines.• Collaboration: Strong team player, fostering trust and alignment across HR functions and business Leaders.• Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities and manage multiple demands effectively.The skills listed reflect what matters most to succeed in this role. If your experience aligns with them, even if your path looks different, we encourage you to apply and start the conversation with us.Take your next stepShape how reward strategies support employee engagement, retention and organisational success. Lead meaningful compensation and benefits initiatives while collaborating with HR teams, business partners and senior leadership to drive impact across the organisation.Grow here. Go further.PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

title: IT Category Lead Buyer (m/f)
description: IT Category Lead BuyerLocations Luxembourgtime type Full timejob requisition id JR000777Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 470 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:‎ IT Category Lead BuyerYour roleReporting to the Central Procurement Manager, the IT Category Lead Buyer will be the primary procurement contact for an assigned portfolio of IT goods and services.The position combines category management with hands-on procurement execution. Operational purchase management• Ensure that purchase orders are issued before supplier delivery or invoicing, except where an authorised exception applies.• Confirm alignment among the purchase order, quotation, contract and approved budget.• Support compliance with procurement procedures, delegated authorities and approved buying channels.• Maintain complete and accurate procurement records in the relevant purchasing and contract-management systems.• Maintain clear trackers for sourcing initiatives, renewals, approvals, security reviews, contracts, purchase orders and invoice exceptions.• Assign actions and target dates to the relevant stakeholders and follow up consistently until closure.Procurement governance and performance management• Deploy Central Procurement policies, procedures, controls and standard templates across the assigned IT category.• Act as the procurement governance point of contact for IT owners, guiding stakeholders through the appropriate sourcing, approval, contracting and purchasing route• Promote the use of approved suppliers, framework agreements, standard contractual terms and consolidated buying channels across the IT category.• Monitor IT suppliers relationships and performance through business reviews, annual scorecards, collection of stakeholders feedback and follow-up of corrective action plansYour profile• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology or a related discipline.• 3–5 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, contract management or purchasing operations.• Professional fluency in English and French• Practical exposure to IT procurement and existing IT suppliers network, preferably covering one or more of the following: software and SaaS; IT hardware; maintenance and support; telecommunications; cloud or hosting services; IT professional or managed services.• Good understanding of purchase-to-pay processes, including requisitions, approvals, purchase orders, goods or service receipt and invoice matching.• Ability to understand commercial IT models such as subscriptions, licences, maintenance, consumption-based services and professional-services engagements.• Strong analytical skills and confidence working with spend, pricing, contract and purchasing data.• Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple renewals and operational priorities simultaneously.• Collaborative and service-oriented approach when working with IT, Finance, Legal, Information Security and business stakeholders.‎Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. title: Chef de Projet Batiment (m/f)
description: CHEF DE PROJET BATIMENT F/HSi le Groupe COSTANTINI s'est d'abord fait un nom dans le domaine du Génie Civil au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg, il couvre aujourd'hui l'ensemble des métiers de la construction.La Construction, l'Entreprise Générale, la Promotion Immobilière, le Montage Immobilier, l'Électricité Générale, la Démolition, le Désamiantage, les Travaux Industriels et aux Particuliers, constituent la large palette des activités proposées au Luxembourg, en France et en Belgique.Prête à relever tous les défis, l'entreprise répond aux besoins les plus divers grâce au dynamisme de ses équipes multidisciplinaires.La recherche constante de qualité, l'amélioration continue, la maîtrise des impacts environnementaux et des risques en termes de santé et de sécurité au travail sont au cœur de notre métier. Nos certifications ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 sont là pour le démontrer.Afin de nous accompagner dans notre développement, nous recherchons un Chef de Projet Batiment F/H pour un recrutement en CDI.ResponsabilitésRattaché au Directeur Travaux de la division Bâtiment, vous avez la charge de :• Gestion globale des chantiers : Suivi technique, organisationnel et financier des opérations (GO/TCE), synthèse et validation des modes opératoires, contrôle des documents contractuels, reporting, suivi de l'échéancier, validation des situations clients et des factures,• Management et coordination des équipes : Encadrement des conducteurs de travaux et chefs de chantier, formation et directives aux N-1, répartition de la charge de travail, analyse des performances et résolution des problématiques humaines,• Relationnel et satisfaction client : Gestion des contentieux, maintien d'un bon relationnel avec MOE/MOA/occupants, garantie de la propreté et de l'accessibilité du chantier, suivi de l'année de parfait achèvement et transfert vers le SAV,• Pilotage et responsabilité financière : Respect des objectifs financiers fixés avec le N+1, arbitrages techniques et économiques, décisions organisationnelles, appui sur les services supports (RH, QSE, juridique, comptabilité, matériel). Compétences requises• Vous justifiez d'une première expérience de minimum 5 années à un poste similaire, en construction neuve,• Titulaire d'un diplôme d'ingénieur ou d'une formation de niveau BAC+5 dans le domaine du BTP,• Doté d'une bonne expertise technique, votre professionnalisme et votre rigueur font de vous un collaborateur impliqué et persuasif pour emmener les équipes vers des projets attractifs et fédérateurs,• Permis B valide obligatoire. Nous offrons• Un poste à pourvoir en CDI à Niederkorn (Differdange),• Rémunération selon profil et expérience,• Véhicule de fonction, carte essence, mutuelle d'entreprise prise en charge à 100% pour le salarié, carte restaurant, prime de la convention collective, revue salariale annuelle.

title: Production Manager (m/f)
description: Description des tâches:LUXUAV is an innovative technology company headquartered in Luxembourg, shaping next-generation airspace security for defence, civil, firefighting and police missions.We build a fully integrated Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) ecosystem that connects mission systems across ground, air, and stratosphere into one coherent governmental and commercial architecture.Job Title: Production ManagerReports to: Chief Operating OfficerRole overview:The Production Manager is responsible for leading the company's production operations, ensuring the safe, efficient and timely manufacture of high-quality unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). The role manages the production team, oversees daily manufacturing activities, and works closely with Engineering, Industrialisation and Quality to deliver products that meet customer expectations, quality standards and business objectives.The Production Manager is accountable for production planning, workforce management, productivity, quality, continuous improvement and operational performance while fostering a positive and engaged team culture.Key ResponsibilitiesProduction Operations• Lead and manage all daily production activities to ensure safe, efficient andon-time delivery of products.• Develop and execute production schedules and targets.• Monitor production progress and adjust resources to meet changing priorities.• Ensure production targets are achieved while maintaining quality and safety standards.• Identify production bottlenecks and implement solutions to improve throughput.• Ensure effective utilisation of labour, equipment, and production resources.Team Leadership• Lead, coach, develop and motivate the production team.• Manage workforce planning, shift allocation and daily work assignments.• Manage performance and provide regular coaching and feedback.• Manage day-to-day employee relations issues within the production team, partnering with HR on formal or complex cases.• Identify training and development needs to enhance team capability.• Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement.Quality• Ensure products are manufactured in accordance with quality requirements; and approved engineering drawings, specifications, Bills of Materials (BOMs) and work instructions developed by the R&D team.• Work closely with the Quality Manager to resolve production quality issues.• Promote a "right first time" approach throughout production.• Ensure production teams understand and comply with quality procedures.• Support non-conformance investigations and implement corrective actions.Production Planning & Performance• Ensure production plan is aligned to meet sales plan and/or customer delivery deadlines.• Ensure production plan and corresponding timely materials procurement requests are factored into the procurement plan.• Monitor production KPIs including output, efficiency, labour utilisation, schedule adherence, rework and productivity.• Analyse production performance and recommend improvements.• Prepare production reports for management.• Support capacity planning and future production growth.Health, Safety & Compliance• Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with health and safety requirements.• Ensure employees follow safe working practices and company procedures.• Participate in risk assessments and incident investigations.• Maintain a clean, organised and safe production environment.Continuous Improvement• Lead continuous improvement initiatives within production (e.g. 5S program implementation).• Improve production workflows, layouts and processes.• Reduce waste, rework and production downtime.• Support Lean manufacturing and other operational excellence initiatives.• Encourage employee suggestions for operational improvements.Inventory & Materials• Work closely with Supply Chain and Procurement to ensure material availability.• Monitor inventory accuracy within the production area.• Ensure appropriate handling and storage of components and finished products.• Minimise material waste and production losses.Cross-functional Collaboration• Collaborate with Engineering and Industrialisation to introduce new products into production.• Support prototype, pilot and low-rate initial production (LRIP) builds.• Provide manufacturing feedback to improve product design and manufacturability.• Support production readiness for new product introductions and engineering changes.Equipment & Facilities• Ensure production equipment is maintained and available.• Report equipment issues and coordinate maintenance activities.• Recommend investments in tools, equipment, and production capability.Qualifications & ExperienceMust have• Bachelor's degree or vocational qualification in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field. Equivalent manufacturing leadership experience will also be considered.• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a manufacturing environment.• Previous experience leading production teams.• Strong understanding of manufacturing operations and production planning.• Understanding of quality management systems and manufacturing quality principles.• Familiarity with health and safety requirements within manufacturing.• Strong leadership and people management skills.• Excellent organisational and planning abilities.• Effective problem-solving and decision-making skills.• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.• Good analytical skills with the ability to interpret production data.• Free criminal record no. 3Nice to have• Experience within electronics, aerospace, defence, automotive, or other high- technology manufacturing environments is advantageous.• Experience introducing new products into production is desirable.• Experience using ERP or manufacturing planning systems is advantageous.• National from a NATO member country or one of the following NATO Indo- Pacific partners: Australia, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand or Ukraine.

title: Temporary Executive Assistant -  Luxembourg
description:
As a (Temporary) Executive Assistant to the CFO, you will provide comprehensive administrative and operational support to a senior executive. Acting as a key business partner, you will ensure the smooth management of the CFO's agenda, travel arrangements, communications, and day-to-day priorities, while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism, confidentiality, and efficiency.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established international organization based in Luxembourg. The company offers a collaborative and professional environment where flexibility, trust, and high performance are valued. You will work closely with executive leadership and gain exposure to strategic business activities while supporting key operational processes.

Description

Executive & Administrative Support
  • Manage the CFO's complex agenda, meetings, appointments, and business commitments.
  • Prepare presentations, reports, meeting packs, and professional correspondence.
  • Screen and prioritize incoming communications, ensuring urgent matters are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, and filing systems.
  • Anticipate administrative needs and provide proactive support on a daily basis.
Travel & Diary Management
  • Coordinate extensive domestic and international travel arrangements, including visas and logistics.
  • Organize flights, accommodation, transportation, and detailed itineraries.
  • Prepare travel documentation and monitor travel-related expenses and reimbursements.
  • Ensure scheduling conflicts are anticipated and resolved efficiently.
Stakeholder & Project Coordination
  • Serve as a key point of contact between the CFO and internal or external stakeholders.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with colleagues, partners, and external contacts.
  • Monitor action points, track deliverables, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Support and coordinate business initiatives, projects, and executive-level meetings.
Office & Operational Support
  • Assist with budget monitoring and expense management across multiple cost centers.
  • Support the implementation and continuous improvement of administrative processes.
  • Coordinate office-related activities and procurement when required.
  • Contribute to the smooth operation of daily business activities.
  • Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Management Assistant, Personal Assistant, or similar role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
  • Proactive, autonomous, and solutions-oriented approach.
  • Service-minded with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams).

title: SENIOR SCIENTIST IN AGENTIC AI FOR ENVIRONMENTAL DIGITAL TWINS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description: Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? LIST is looking for an experienced Senior Scientist to strengthen its capabilities in agentic artificial intelligence for geospatial and environmental applications, with a particular focus on large language models (LLMs), scientific workflow orchestration and space-enabled environmental digital twins. The successful candidate will join the Remote Sensing and Natural Resources Modelling (REMOTE) group, an interdisciplinary team combining Earth Observation (EO), environmental modelling, AI, data assimilation and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication networks. Our ambition is to turn cutting-edge AI and space-enabled technologies into solutions for disaster risk reduction, resilient agri-food systems, terrestrial ecosystem resilience, civil security and humanitarian action. The new colleague will contribute to ongoing RDI projects while progressively developing new methodologies, collaborations and research directions with the group's scientists. Building on REMOTE's established expertise in AI for Earth Observation, multimodal satellite-data analysis and environmental modelling, the successful candidate will bring complementary expertise in the design of reliable LLM-based agentic systems that can reason across EO datasets, scientific knowledge, models and services; plan and execute scientific workflows; verify results; and communicate uncertainties and findings transparently. Experience with vision-language models (VLMs) and geospatial foundation models would further strengthen multimodal and spatial reasoning. A central objective is to enable users to interact more intuitively with environmental digital twins: formulate questions in natural language, identify suitable observations and models, configure and run simulations, compare alternative scenarios, and receive scientifically grounded, interpretable answers. Illustrative “what-if” questions include:• Flood risk: How would altered precipitation patterns or proposed flood-protection measures affect inundation extent, water depth and the exposure of buildings in urban catchments? An agentic workflow could combine historical and near-real-time satellite observations, hydrological and hydraulic models, and alternative climate or adaptation scenarios to compare risk-reduction options.• Agriculture: How might prolonged drought, altered irrigation practices or a warmer growing season affect crop water stress and yield at field or regional scale? A digital twin could couple EO-derived soil moisture, crop water stress, land surface temperature and evapotranspiration with crop models, AI and data assimilation to compare management options. These examples illustrate the approach rather than prescribe a narrow project portfolio. The role is cross-cutting: the selected scientist will work with domain experts, build on existing digital twin activities in urban, coastal and agricultural systems, and explore synergies with distributed sensing, IoT and satellite-enabled connectivity. Awareness of the European digital-twin and data-space ecosystem will help position developments for interoperability and collaboration. Relevant initiatives include Destination Earth (DestinE), ESA Digital Twin Earth and EO Digital Twin Components, as well as EU-funded ecosystem and biodiversity digital-twin projects such as TerraTwin and BioDT. Complementary initiatives, including the European Green Deal Data Space and the Common European Agricultural Data Space, provide a framework for interoperable and trusted data sharing across stakeholders. The selected researcher will be mainly in charge of:• Designing and evaluating LLM-based, tool-using and multi-agent systems to orchestrate EO data access, geospatial processing, environmental models, simulations and digital-twin services.• Translating natural-language questions into traceable model configurations and executable workflows, with robust planning, verification, spatial/temporal reasoning, uncertainty handling and explainable outputs.• Contributing to ongoing interdisciplinary RDI projects and co-developing scalable, reproducible solutions with EO scientists, environmental modellers and infrastructure specialists.• Connecting AI workflows with cloud/HPC environments, research infrastructures and, where relevant, distributed sensing and terrestrial/non-terrestrial communication systems, working with infrastructure specialists to support interoperable access to IoT sensor streams, satellite observations, weather data and model services across stakeholders, with appropriate data governance and traceability.• Initiating and leading new interdisciplinary research projects, partnerships and competitive proposals; supervising researchers; and disseminating and valorising results. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education• PhD in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Geoinformatics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a related discipline. Experience and skills• Established scientific track record in AI, with demonstrated hands-on expertise in LLMs and agentic AI systems, including tool use, planning, orchestration and interaction with external APIs, data services or scientific models.• Strong understanding of modern foundation-model methods and development frameworks, such as retrieval-augmented generation, context engineering, multi-agent architectures and systematic model/agent evaluation.• Ability to design robust, reproducible computational workflows with appropriate validation, uncertainty assessment, traceability and interpretability; strong programming skills.• Working knowledge of EO/geospatial data and an aptitude for spatial and temporal reasoning; motivation to apply advanced AI to practical environmental and societal challenges.• Collaborative and interdisciplinary mindset, with the ability to contribute to ongoing research activities and leverage complementary expertise in Earth Observation, environmental sciences and modelling.• Demonstrated experience in scientific leadership, developing competitive research proposals, building national and international collaborations, supervising researchers and publishing high-quality scientific work. Language skills• Fluency in spoken and written English; French, German and/or Luxembourgish would be an asset. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month [...]

title: Job på Malta - Administrativ kundeservice - I gaming - Book en samtale i dag!
description:
Drømmer du om at kombinere et socialt arbejdsliv med sol, hav og et ungt dansk team?

Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor tempo, samarbejde og personlighed betyder lige så meget som erfaring? Så har du muligheden for at blive en del af et lille, tæt dansk team i Sliema, hvor du arbejder med kundesupport for flere etablerede brands.

Du bliver en vigtig del af et team på otte danske kolleger, hvor man lægger stor vægt på personlighed, trivsel og fællesskab. Her handler det ikke kun om at yde god kundeservice — men også om at fungere godt socialt, bidrage til stemningen og være en del af et miljø, hvor man både arbejder og laver ting sammen uden for kontoret.

Vi leder efter en udadvendt og engageret person, der motiveres af at skabe gode kundeoplevelser og som trives i et miljø, hvor man hurtigt bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Hvad laver en administrativ kundeservicemedarbejder?

Du besvarer kundehenvendelser via e-mail og chat og sikrer, at hver kunde får en professionel og hjælpsom oplevelse. Du hjælper med teknisk support, guider kunder gennem platformen og sørger for, at eventuelle problemer bliver løst hurtigt og korrekt. Du overvåger også hjemmesidens funktionalitet og rapporterer fejl eller driftsproblemer til teamlederen. Derudover hjælper du med at promovere nye produkter og kampagner og støtter teamet i ad hoc-opgaver, når der er behov.

title: Kundeservice søges til Malta - Betalt relokation
description:
Kundeservice søges til Malta – God løn, bonus og relocation-pakke

Kunne du tænke dig at kombinere en international karriere med livet på Malta?

Vi søger lige nu en dansktalende Kundeservice til en langsigtet stilling hos en international bank på Malta.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor du arbejder med danske kunder og får mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice, salg og den finansielle sektor.

Stillingen er særligt interessant for dig, der allerede har erfaring med kundeservice eller salg – og måske har erfaring som Team Leader eller med KPI'er og dataanalyse.

OM JOBBET

Som Kundeservice bliver du en del af et team, der håndterer kundeservice, onboarding, salg og betalinger.

Du vil blandt andet:

• Besvare kundehenvendelser via telefon, live chat, email og SMS

• Hjælpe kunder med information om bankens produkter, services og betalinger

• Håndtere spørgsmål og henvendelser fra danske kunder

• Arbejde tæt sammen med betalings- og collectionsafdelingen

• Følge gældende procedurer, regler og lovgivning

• Arbejde med salg og aktivt identificere relevante salgsmuligheder

• Sikre en professionel og effektiv kundeoplevelse

Du refererer direkte til den danske Team Leader og bliver en del af et internationalt arbejdsmiljø.

HVORFOR MALTA?

Malta er en populær destination for danskere, der ønsker at kombinere arbejde med livet i udlandet.

Her får du mulighed for at bo på en middelhavsø med et internationalt miljø, gode strande, restauranter, et aktivt socialt liv og masser af muligheder for at opleve øen.

Virksomheden arrangerer blandt andet ugentlige Friday Drinks og forskellige sociale arrangementer, hvor du kan lære dine kollegaer og Malta bedre at kende.

HVAD FÅR DU?

✈️ Op til €1.000 i relocation-refusion til kandidater, der flytter til Malta

Refusionen kan blandt andet bruges til fly, taxi og dokumenterede udgifter i forbindelse med flytningen

God Løn

10% bonus udbetalt kvartalsvist

Mulighed for yderligere bonus efter 6 måneders ansættelse

️ 24 feriedage + 14 helligdage

Health & Life Insurance efter 6 måneders prøvetid

Gratis frugt, brød og morgenmadsprodukter på arbejdspladsen

Friday Drinks og andre sociale arrangementer

Gode muligheder for intern udvikling – både til andre afdelinger og management

Langsigtet kontrakt

HVEM ER DU?

Vi leder efter dig, der:

• Har gode engelskkundskaber både skriftligt og mundtligt

• Har erfaring fra kundeservice eller salg

• Er vant til at arbejde med KPI'er og data

• Er engageret, professionel og ansvarsbevidst

• Kan arbejde struktureret og følge procedurer

• Er god til at kommunikere med kunder og kollegaer

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra kundeservice, salg eller den finansielle sektor, men det vigtigste er, at du er engageret, professionel og pålidelig.

PRAKTISK INFORMATION

Malta – Msida

Fuldtid

40 timer om ugen

Langsigtet kontrakt

1 dags oplæring

6 måneders prøvetid

Opfølgende reviews efter 1, 3 og 6 måneder

Hvis du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere, samtidig med at du får mulighed for at bo og arbejde på Malta, er dette en spændende mulighed.

Der er en ledig stilling.
