title: AI in RAN System Developer
description: Company description:Ericsson ABJob description:   Join our Team   About this opportunity: Artificial Intelligence is rapidly becoming a key enabler for future Radio Access Networks. We are looking for an experienced AI in RAN System Developer who is passionate about applying machine learning and  advanced analytics  to solve real-world telecom challenges.    In this role, you will contribute from early phase systemization to development of AI-enabled RAN functions that improve network performance, optimize resource utilization and enhance the end-user experience. The focus is on AI for RAN functionality and embedded   You will work with some of the industry’s most advanced Radio Access Network technologies, including latest NR Advanced capabilities, while contributing to the journey toward 6G and AI-native networks. Working alongside experts in RAN architecture, radio algorithms, system design, software development and research, you will help shape how AI becomes an integral part of future wireless systems.    This is an opportunity to combine cutting-edge Machine Learning with carrier-grade radio technology, where solutions must be productized and executed efficiently within strict real-time, compute, memory, power and latency constraints.    What you will do: •    Drive the system design of AI/ML-enabled RAN functions and algorithms, ensuring that machine learning techniques can be productized and executed efficiently within real-time RAN systems. •    Analyze data and translate insights into deployable capabilities that can improve network efficiency, latency, throughput, capacity, reliability and user experience. •    Design meaningful experiments, data collection strategies and validation methodologies to assess the effectiveness, feasibility and product impact of AI-driven solutions. •    Evaluate technical and business problems and determine when machine learning provides value compared with classical algorithmic approaches, avoiding indiscriminate use of AI.  •    Work closely with engineering teams to integrate AI solutions into existing RAN products, software platforms and development flows, from early prototype and proof-of-concept work to production-quality implementation. •    Optimize AI models for deployment under finite CPU, memory, power and latency budgets, balancing AI accuracy against computational cost and operational value. •    Contribute to the evolution of AI methodologies, lifecycle practices, tooling and best practices for RAN products and future AI-native networks.    The skills you bring: •    Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Telecommunications or a related discipline. •    Strong Machine Learning fundamentals, including supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning, feature engineering and feature selection, model training, validation, performance evaluation, statistical analysis and data-driven decision making. •    Experience with resource-constrained systems, including the ability to design models that fit within finite CPU, memory, power and latency budgets. •    Understanding of inference optimization, model compression, quantization, pruning, acceleration techniques and deployment feasibility on embedded or telecom platforms. •    Strong software engineering skills, including modern C++, Python for AI experimentation and prototyping, software architecture understanding, CI/CD and the ability to move from prototype to production software. •    Understanding of telecom and RAN systems, preferably within areas such as scheduling, mobility, link adaptation, RRM algorithms, O&M systems or performance management.

title: Principal Engineer - Payments
description: Vill du utveckla betalningslösningar som behöver fungera stabilt dygnet runt och hantera stora transaktionsvolymer? Hos oss får du kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med stort inflytande över en av ATG:s mest affärskritiska tekniska domäner. Vi söker en Principal Engineer som drivs av tekniskt hantverk, gillar att lösa svåra problem och vill utveckla både system och människor omkring sig. I rollen får du:    Utveckla affärskritiska betalningstjänster och integrationer med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet, prestanda och skalbarhet.    Ta en ledande roll i tekniska vägval, systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur, samtidigt som du fortsätter vara hands-on i utvecklingen.    Komma in tidigt i större initiativ, exempelvis vid nya betalningslösningar och integrationer, och identifiera tekniska möjligheter, beroenden och risker.    Driva tekniska frågor över teamgränser och vara en brygga mellan utvecklare, arkitekter, produkt och andra delar av organisationen.    Skapa teknisk riktning i teamet, coacha andra utvecklare och bidra till att höja teamets samlade tekniska förmåga.Payments är en central del av ATG:s digitala ekosystem. Teamet ansvarar för tekniska lösningar kopplade till digitala betalningar, bland annat insättningar och uttag. Du arbetar i en miljö där stora transaktionsvolymer möter integrationer mot externa Payment Service Providers och där området fortsätter utvecklas i takt med nya marknader och betalningsmetoder.Är det här du?Vi tror att du är en mycket erfaren backendutvecklare som fortfarande tycker om att skriva kod och gå på djupet i komplexa tekniska problem. Samtidigt lyfter du naturligt blicken från den egna lösningen och ser hur system, team och beroenden hänger ihop.Du är trygg i att skapa teknisk riktning och tar initiativ när en lösning kräver samarbete över teamgränser. Med teknisk trovärdighet och tydlig kommunikation skapar du samsyn och får andra med dig i komplexa tekniska vägval. Du har också förmågan att göra teknisk komplexitet begriplig och tydliggöra konsekvenser av tekniska problem och beslut för olika delar av organisationen.Vi ser att du har erfarenhet av:    Java och/eller Kotlin, gärna med Spring och Hibernate.    Mikrotjänster, distribuerade system och messaging, exempelvis JMS.    AWS eller motsvarande modern molnplattform.    Kubernetes.    SQL och databaser.    Systemdesign och lösningsarkitektur för system med höga krav på tillgänglighet, säkerhet och prestanda.    Tekniskt ledarskap där du skapat riktning, stöttat andra utvecklare och omsatt komplexa behov till hållbara tekniska lösningar.Extra intressant är erfarenhet från:    Fintech eller andra verksamheter med affärskritiska transaktionsflöden.We are the gameI mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.Join the game!Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!Så här har vi detHos oss är du del av en innovativ miljö och med hjälp av den senaste tekniken utvecklar du den bästa spelupplevelsen. Vi gillar att samarbeta och hos oss får du stort utrymme att påverka ditt arbetssätt. Här hittar du nyfikna, nytänkande medarbetare och ledare – viktiga egenskaper för att kunna utveckla och utvecklas. Liksom energi , mod och motivation.För att må bra är skrattmuskeln lika viktig att träna som alla andra muskler. Både den fysiska och den mentala hälsan skapar balans i livet. Hur vi har det på jobbet påverkar privatlivet- och vice versa. Vi ser det som en självklarhet att ge det stöd och de verktyg som behövs. Ditt val av arbetsplats och arbetssätt är flexibelt och vi lägger stor vikt på självledarskap.Vi bryr oss om varandra och respekterar varandras olikheter på ATG. Och vi vill att våra kunder ska må bra och ha roligt när de spelar. Vi bryr oss också om sportens välmående, dvs. idrottarna och hästarna - och samhället runt omkring oss. Vi drivs inte av privata vinstintressen utan allt överskott går tillbaka till våra ägare, svensk trav- och galoppsport, något som både känns och gör gott.

title: Director, Operations IT - MES, Product Management
description: Job Title: Director, Operations IT - Manufacturing Execution Systems, Product ManagementLocation: Södertälje, SwedenLocation note: Suitable applicants from other AZ hub/Operations sites may be considered We are looking for a visionary and experienced IT Director to lead the global strategy, implementation and optimization of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) across our pharmaceutical operations. In this high-impact role, you will drive digital transformation, ensure alignment between technology and business priorities, and help advance manufacturing efficiency, quality and compliance. This is an exciting opportunity to combine strategic leadership, technology and manufacturing expertise while making an impact across a global organization. The role is based in Södertälje, Sweden. The Manufacturing IT capability is a global capability within Operations IT, responsible for delivering strategic digital technologies that enable safe, compliant and efficient manufacturing across AstraZeneca's Operations network. The team spans Manufacturing Execution Systems, Manufacturing Optimisation, Plant Maintenance, Warehouse Management, and Autonomous Manufacturing, working closely with manufacturing sites, enterprise IT teams and strategic technology partners to develop scalable global solutions through platform and product management. Budget and Vendor Management:    Manage the MES program budget and ensure cost-effective solutions.    Evaluate, select, and manage relationships with MES vendors and third-party service providers. Essential requirements for the role:    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field    Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in IT within manufacturing, with at least 5 years in a leadership role focusing on MES    Strong understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing, GMP practices, and regulatory frameworks    Proficiency in MES platforms (Werum PAS-X and/or Tulip) and their integration with ERP and automation systems    Proven ability to lead global teams and manage complex, large-scale projects    Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical challenges and deliver solutions    Proven ability to work with external vendors    Proven ability to work with global teams in relation to MES platforms    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills Work policy:When we put people in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. This role is located in Södertälje, Sweden and is not available for remote work or with travel or commuting support. Why AstraZeneca:Join a team with the backing and investment to win! You'll be working with cutting-edge technology. This marriage between our purposeful work and the use of high-tech platforms is what sets us apart. Lead the way in digital healthcare. From exploring data and AI to working in the cloud on new technologies. Join a team at the forefront. Help shape and define the technologies of the future, with the backing you need from across the business. What's next:If this sounds like the place and role for you - apply today! We look forward to getting to know you better! Welcome with your application no later than November 30, 2026.

title: Postdoc position in Applied Geochemistry
description: Do you want to develop your research and teaching in an environment where collaboration with industry and society is a natural part of the work? With us, you will collaborate with dedicated colleagues, have access to modern research infrastructure, and enjoy strong opportunities to attract external funding. You will have the space to make a real difference for your students, your research, and society at large.In the research subject Applied Geochemistry at the Department of Civil, Environmental and Natural Resources Engineering, Luleå University of Technology (LTU), we are looking for a Postdoc Researcher. Applied Geochemistry at LTU focuses on the occurrence and mobility of elements and geochemical processes that occur in rock, soil, and water at the Earth’s surface. Research is conducted on natural and anthropogenic sources and their interactions within and between the atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere. This is achieved by combining analytical chemistry, isotopic geochemistry, environmental forensics, and environmental mineralogy. Research and education in this subject address environmental issues tied to the mining industry, infrastructure construction, acid sulphate soils, and sulphide-bearing rocks. The research group has a strong experimental and applied profile, with well-equipped laboratories and extensive collaborations with industry and the public sector, all geared towards building a long-term, sustainable society.Subject descriptionApplied Geochemistry is concerned with studies into the occurrence and mobility of the elements in rocks, soil, and water, focusing on methods to prevent or reduce the environmental impact of metal extraction and infrastructure development.BackgroundThe position will support the Swedish Research Council (Vetenskapsrådet) funded PhD Research School on Mining and Mineral Research – BioGeoMetals, a national collaboration between Linnaeus University (coordinator), Luleå University of Technology (LTU), and KTH Royal Institute of Technology. BioGeoMetals focuses on biogeochemical and hydrogeochemical approaches for sustainable metal recovery and environmental management in mining environments. The research school addresses the mobilization and recovery of critical raw materials from mining waste rock, tailings, groundwater, or run-off waters, as well as bioremediation of impacted mine sites. Through interdisciplinary doctoral training, joint courses, and close collaboration with industry and public authorities, the research school aims to educate the next generation of researchers contributing to sustainable mining and responsible resource management in Sweden and beyond.Project descriptionThe project will investigate how microbiology can be used in geochemical exploration to find ore deposits. Characterisation of solids, liquids and microbes in mining environments (e.g. tailings, mine water, and waste rock) will serve as the base for subsequent brown- and greenfield exploration trials. The successful candidate will focus on the characterisation of solids and closely work with the PhDs and partners in the project.The work will cover:- Laboratory and field investigations- Mineralogical, geochemical and petrographic characterization- Development of analytical methods and exploration strategiesDutiesAs a Postdoc, you will:- Conduct field sampling of solid phases (rock, soil, till, sediments)- Perform laboratory-based geochemical and mineralogical analyses- Integrate and interpret multi-disciplinary datasets- Design methods of mineral exploration- Co-supervise PhD's- Teach in geology-related courses- Publish results in peer-reviewed scientific journals- Present findings at national and international conferencesQualificationsWe are looking for a motivated candidate with a strong interest in exploration, geochemistry, field and laboratory work, microbiology, and sustainable mining.You must have:- A PhD degree in geology, geochemistry, environmental geoscience, or a closely related field- Good oral and written proficiency in English- Experience in conducting field work- Expertise in soil-related exploration- Strong background in characterisation techniques- A driving licenseMeritorious qualifications include:- SEM-based automated mineralogy- Heavy mineral concentration expertisePersonal qualities such as analytical ability, independence, collaboration skills, and strong motivation for research will be given significant weight.Further information This is a full-time, fixed-term position as a postdoctoral researcher for two years, with the possibility of extension. The position is based in Luleå. Start date: January 2027 or according to agreement.For each position, a preliminary salary range https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Thomas Aiglsperger, +46 920-491016, thomas.aiglsperger@ltu.se, or Oscar Paulsson oscar.paulsson@ltu.sehttps://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-TradeunioncontactsIn case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions of this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.ApplicationWe prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.Closing date for applications: December 10, 2026Reference number: 5860-2026

title: Market Development Specialist
description: Are you a commercially driven professional who enjoys building business relationships, identifying market opportunities and turning insights into business growth?EPD International, a wholly owned subsidiary of IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute, is looking for a Market Development Specialist (parental leave cover) to join our market team and contribute to our continued international growth. We operate the International EPD System, helping businesses communicate their products’ environmental impact through independently verified Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs).As sustainability, digitalization and regulatory developments create new business opportunities, you will combine B2B sales and stakeholder engagement with strategic market analysis and business development in a rapidly evolving industry. About the roleAs Market Development Specialist, you will play an important role in strengthening our market position, developing commercial relationships and identifying new business opportunities. You will investigate market potential, understand customer needs and industry developments, and build a clear view of where our efforts can have the greatest impact. Working closely with the Market Team, CEO and colleagues across the organisation, you will translate your findings into recommendations and targeted market development initiatives.  This experienced individual contributor role has no direct sales targets or people management responsibilities. You will have substantial autonomy and the opportunity to influence market priorities, combining analytical work with external engagement and hands-on implementation. What you will do The role combines two equally important areas:Market Analysis & Business Development    Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, opportunities and potential growth areas.    Develop business strategies and commercial models for new and existing services.    Support the development and alignment of commercial agreements, partnership frameworks and related documentation in collaboration with relevant internal experts.    Identify and develop new opportunities for collaboration with strategic partners.    Translate market insights into concrete business recommendations and actionable initiatives.Sales & Stakeholder Relations    Drive B2B sales activities, from identifying potential customers and partners to developing opportunities and closing deals.    Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including manufacturers, LCA consultancies, industry organisations and technology providers.    Identify customer needs and translate them into commercial opportunities.    Develop strategic collaborations that strengthen our market presence and generate long-term business value.    Represent EPD International in customer meetings and industry events. What you bringWe are looking for a commercially minded and analytical professional who enjoys combining relationship-building with strategic thinking and hands-on execution. We believe you have:    At least +3 years professional experience in business development, market analysis or commercial strategy.    Proven experience in B2B sales and market development, preferably in an international environment.    A demonstrated ability to build relationships, identify opportunities and generate business results.    The ability to move from analysis to implementation and take ownership of projects from initial investigation through delivery and follow-up.     Experience working with business models, partnerships or commercial agreements.    Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English, both written and spoken.    A relevant university degree in business, marketing, economics, engineering or a related field. It is an advantage if you also have:    Experience in sustainability, environmental services, construction products or related industries.    Knowledge of LCAs, EPDs or environmental product information.    Experience with digital services, data platforms, APIs or subscription-based business models.    Experience working with international partner networks. Why EPD InternationalWe work independently to help organisations worldwide publish third-party verified decision-grade environmental data, guided by a vision of transparent, credible and comparable information for everyone to support decisions that benefit the planet. You will help shape our market priorities and contribute to the wider use of credible environmental information. Working at EPD International you will create green positive impact in an international context, you will have the opportunity to turn market understanding into initiatives that make a tangible difference to the reach and adoption of the International EPD System. Interested in helping us identify and develop our next market opportunities? We welcome your application.About the jobLocation: Stockholm Company: EPD International (part of IVL Swedish Environmental Research Institute) Reports to: Chief Operating Officer (COO), EPD International Employment type: Fixed-term parental leave cover, with the possibility of an extension Duration: Ideally from 1 February to 31 December 2027.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Vitec BidTheatre
description: Vitec BidTheatre builds software and solutions for data-driven online marketing. Our platform enables media agencies, brands and other marketing professionals to manage and deliver programmatic advertising campaigns.We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our small engineering team in Stockholm. The position offers a high degree of independence, technical ownership and the opportunity to influence the continued development of our platform.About the roleAs a member of our engineering team, you will work across our technology stack, developing and maintaining the applications and services that power our advertising platform.A key part of your role will be taking the lead in the continued development of BidTheatre Studio, our web application used by clients and internal teams to manage digital advertising campaigns. You will have significant influence over frontend architecture, technical decisions and development practices.Beyond the frontend, you will also be actively involved in developing and maintaining our backend systems, including APIs, business logic and data processing. We are looking for someone with solid experience in both frontend and backend development who is comfortable taking responsibility across the entire application stack.Our frontend uses React, TypeScript and Redux. Our backend is primarily Java-based, with technologies such as SQL, Redis, Aerospike, Kafka and Spark supporting our data-intensive platform.We embrace modern development practices, including AI-assisted coding, and encourage experimentation with tools that improve productivity and code quality.We believe you are an experienced and versatile developer who enjoys understanding how systems work as a whole. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks, making technical decisions and working independently, while collaborating closely with your colleagues.Requirements    5+ years of professional software development experience    Strong experience with React, TypeScript and modern frontend development    Solid professional experience in backend development using Java or comparable technologies such as C#/.NET or Kotlin    Ability and willingness to work with Java-based backend systems    Good understanding of SQL and relational databases    Experience developing and maintaining larger web applications    Good understanding of software architecture, performance and maintainability    Ability to independently drive technical decisions and development    Experience with Git, testing and modern development practices    Good written and spoken English skillsNice to have    Experience with Redux Toolkit, RTK Query or Redux Saga    Experience with distributed or high-volume systems    Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Codex, Claude Code or similar    Interest in UX/UI design    Experience with ad tech or programmatic advertising    Degree in Computer Science    Fluency in SwedishWhat we offerYou will be part of a small, experienced engineering team where your contributions make a real difference. You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work, influence technical decisions and contribute across different parts of a complex platform.Our systems handle large volumes of data and real-time transactions, offering a broad range of technical challenges in a profitable and established software business.Application: The application deadline is 13th of December 2026. We encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible, as applications are reviewed and interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Andreas Green at Andreas.Green@vitecsoftware.com.Location: The position is based at our office in Stockholm.Start date: As soon as possible, by agreement.About Vitec BidTheatreBidTheatre DSP is a programmatic marketing platform built for media agencies, advertisers and integrators. With BidTheatre, marketers get unified and efficient access to the fragmented media landscape with banner, video, audio, native, CTV, and digital out of home (DOOH) advertising. The platform can be used to launch awareness building or conversion driving advertising campaigns, target niche audiences and gain marketing insights. BidTheatre is an independent and close partner that puts transparency and innovation in the forefront. BidTheatre has offices in Stockholm and Oslo and has been part of Vitec Software Group since 2024 Read more at bidtheatre.com.About Vitec Software GroupVitec is a leading provider of Vertical Software and has its origin and headquarters in Umeå, Sweden. Our products have been developed to meet specific needs within various niche markets in society. The expertise of our employees, combined with our shared corporate culture and business model, enable continuous improvement and innovation. We grow through the successes of our business units, as well as through acquisitions. Everything we do is based on a long-term perspective. Because we are to rely on – today and tomorrow. Vitec has 1,870 employees, is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm and had net sales of SEK 3,633 million in 2025. Read more at vitecsoftware.com.

title: IT Support Technician for an International MedTech Company!
description: Are you a service-oriented problem solver? On behalf of our client, we are currently looking for an IT Support Technician in Stockholm for a 1-year temporary position. Become a key player at a global MedTech company whose tools make a difference in healthcare. Apply today!About the roleOur client is an established and innovative Swedish medical technology company that develops digital decision-support tools to facilitate and ensure quality in assessments and treatment follow-ups within neuropsychiatry. With headquarters in Stockholm and operations in the UK and the USA, among other countries, the company is characterized by an open, multicultural, and family-like atmosphere where technology and societal benefit go hand in hand.As one of the colleagues on the team is going on study leave, we are now looking for a replacement for a one-year temporary position to secure daily IT delivery, starting with a thorough handover in December.In the role of IT Support Technician, you will serve as the hub for daily technical support at the Stockholm office, while also supporting colleagues at the London office remotely. You will work broadly with 1st line support (with the opportunity to take on 2nd line tickets as you grow into the role) in a mixed Windows and macOS environment. At the Stockholm office, there is an open "digital workplace" area where employees can drop by for quick assistance, making you a visible and appreciated point of contact for the entire organization. In addition to your colleagues at the office, you will collaborate closely with your own international IT team—consisting of colleagues in Stockholm, the UK, and the USA—holding weekly check-ins to distribute workload and drive tickets forward.You are offered:    An international and welcoming workplace where you contribute to products that make a real difference for both healthcare providers and patients.    The opportunity to work broadly in a modern Microsoft environment with great prospects for technical development toward 2nd line support and automation.    A solid introduction at our client's company with a structured and thorough handover from your current colleague.Work tasks    Daily Support & Ticket Management: Provide 1st line IT support (and 2nd line, depending on experience) on-site in Stockholm and remotely for the UK, as well as manage incoming tickets in Jira Service Management.      User & Device Management: Take responsibility for onboarding and offboarding, hardware and license management (asset management), and administration in Microsoft 365, Entra ID (SSO), and Intune.      Troubleshooting & IT Security: Troubleshoot in Windows and macOS, trace phishing emails in Microsoft Defender, escalate incidents, and work with existing scripts in PowerShell and Microsoft Graph.We are looking for    Has 3–5 years of experience working in IT support or a similar IT service role.    Has a strong technical understanding and practical experience working in a Microsoft environment, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, and Defender.    Has strong troubleshooting skills in both Windows and macOS.    Has a strong security mindset and understands the importance of regulatory compliance and data security.    Has very good proficiency in English, both spoken and written, as it is the corporate language and you will communicate daily with colleagues in the UK and the USA. Knowledge of Swedish is a plus.It is considered meritorious if you have:    Experience with ticket management in Jira Service Management.    Basic knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or AI tools to streamline workflows.    Previous experience from a regulated industry, such as MedTech or Life Science.To succeed in this role, you have the following personal qualities:We place great emphasis on your personal qualities and are looking for someone who is distinctly service-oriented, helpful, and unpretentious. Since you will meet colleagues both via the ticketing system and face-to-face at the office, you are communicative, patient, and able to explain technical solutions in a pedagogical way to people without a technical background. Furthermore, you are structured, thorough, and enjoy collaborating in an international team where everyone pitches in to solve tasks.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Logistics Technician
description: OverviewAs a Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT) at Microsoft, you will support the inventory and asset management processes that keep our datacentres operating efficiently. You will conduct cycle audits, manage incoming and outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and maintain accurate delivery and inventory records.This hands-on role provides an opportunity to develop your knowledge of inventory management, logistics, warranty processes, and secure data-bearing device destruction while building your career within Microsoft’s global datacentre operations.This is an on-site position. As public transport to the location is limited, having your own transportation is recommended.Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) organisation powers services including Azure, Office 365, Bing, Xbox, and OneDrive. CO+I provides the infrastructure and technologies behind Microsoft’s global cloud platform, while supporting employee development through training, professional certifications, career programmes, and growth opportunities.Microsoft operates more than 200 datacentres across 32 countries, supporting over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. Sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence are central to how we design and operate our global infrastructure.Our mission is to empower every person and organisation on the planet to achieve more. Guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability, we foster an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.Responsibilities    Perform inventory and asset management tasks, escalating issues during high-volume or complex situations when required.    Coordinate with suppliers on warranty claims and Return Merchandise Authorisation (RMA) processes, including processing, packaging, shipping, receiving, and tracking hardware.    Complete assigned tasks independently using established processes and sound judgement.    Maintain accurate records across inventory, configuration, and asset management systems.    Conduct physical inventory tracking, staging, cycle counts, and audits.    Reconcile and report inventory discrepancies.    Perform secure destruction of data-bearing devices (DBDs) in accordance with Microsoft policies and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).    Monitor stock levels and notify management of shortages or replenishment requirements.    Support incoming and outgoing deliveries and maintain accurate documentation.    Comply with security, data management, and operational policies.    Embody Microsoft’s culture and values.QualificationsRequired Qualifications    High School Diploma or equivalent, with experience in warehouse operations, supply chain, inventory management, retail, IT environments, logistics, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.    Valid driver’s licence and ability to travel between sites when required.Background Check RequirementsCandidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements, including:    Successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.Preferred Qualifications    Experience in warehouse, supply chain, logistics, inventory management, or related operations within an IT or technology environment.    Experience operating material-handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, or chassis lifts within a large-scale operational environment; or equivalent experience.

title: Digital Design Lead - Digital Journey
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description: Job DescriptionWHAT YOU’LL DO As Design Lead within Digital Journey, you will shape and manage the end-to-end customer journeys across H&M’s digital channels. You will turn customer insights, user and commercial data into a clear view of the holistic experience, shared priorities across areas and product teams, and measurable outcomes. You will connect the product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams that shape every step of the journey, and manage journeys as living systems.     Establish and drive the vision, goals, roadmap and priorities for customer journeys in line with H&M’s customer and business strategy.     Prioritise improvements to the customer journey and be accountable for journey maps and service blueprints developed together with relevant roles.     Combine customer feedback, research, behavioural data and commercial performance to identify pain points and opportunity spaces, and prioritise improvements with evidence.     Support the definition of journey metrics and KPIs with relevant stakeholders, linking customer outcomes to business value.     Run effective journey governance with clear roles, regular check-ins and early resolution of overlapping or conflicting initiatives.     Coordinate product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams so that changes across channels fit together.     Work with data and tech teams to connect data and tools, enabling continuous monitoring of journey performance.     Partner with design and research to test and iterate solutions, and with orchestration teams to deliver more personalised customer interactions.     Build journey-management capability through shared practices and clear communication.     Demonstrate the business value of journey improvements by connecting them to outcomes such as revenue, churn and repeat purchase.     Align each product team’s contribution with the holistic customer journey and support personalisation of the H&M digital experience. Work closely with Product Managers and Area Business Managers on this.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of Digital Product Design and work broadly work across product, digital design, technology, marketing, retail tech, customer service, data, analytics and research. The role requires close partnership with senior stakeholders and teams across H&M to create shared direction, resolve dependencies and ensure that improvements across channels deliver one coherent customer experience. You will report to the Journey Manager and, while your organisational home is Design, your scope and collaboration will span the functions that shape the end-to-end customer journey. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with…     A background within in customer experience, service design or product management. Experience from other relevant disciplines, such as marketing, technology or data and analytics, is a plus, ideally within a large international organisation.     Proven experience managing end-to-end customer journeys or services across multiple channels, touchpoints and teams.      Experience building journey-management capability in organisations through coaching, training, playbooks, frameworks, practices or communities.     Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and align product, technology, marketing and other teams without direct authority.     Hands-on experience in journey mapping and service blueprinting, ideally across both digital and physical touchpoints.     Experience combining qualitative research, journey analytics, behavioural data, commercial data and voice-of-customer insight.     Experience defining metrics that connect customer experience with business results such as revenue and churn.     Experience with journey-management tools, data integration, governance and ways of working across siloed teams in agile organisations. We will give special consideration to candidates with experience using AI tools to build, visualise and analyse journeys.     Experience building evidence-based business cases and prioritising journey pain points and opportunities. And people who are…     Customer-centric and able to balance customer needs with product and business goals.     Collaborative and influential, with the ability to create shared direction across functions and levels of seniority.     Clear and transparent communicators who use evidence to make complex topics understandable.     Curious, proactive and open to experimentation, new tools and changing ways of working.     Accountable and action-oriented, with a focus on quality, follow-through and continuous improvement.     Resourceful problem-solvers who can navigate ambiguity, resistance and competing priorities.  Additional InformationWho We AreH&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.   We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   This role is based out of Stockholm, Sweden. For this we role are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. Applicants must have existing work authorization for the country in which the role is located.  Why You'll Love Working Here At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits.

stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement. operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.    Strong architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones description: På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. You will also showcase your abilities by providing ideas and by being able to work both while managing your own tasks and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.You will be reporting to the R&D Electromechanical Chapter Leader and joining the Load Control Agile Unit based in Västerås, Sweden. description: Job ID: 6455Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery of critical technology capabilities enabling safe, scalable and compliant AI adoption across Nordea. In this role, you will lead a portfolio of interdependent initiatives spanning AI governance, Identity & Access Management, network connectivity and security. technology-enabler initiatives across IAM, network and security domains.    Establish and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.    Coordinate delivery across architecture, AI platform, IAM, network, security, cloud, risk, compliance and business teams.    Translate AI platform and governance roadmaps into executable programmes and clearly sequenced delivery plans.    Drive the implementation of foundational capabilities required for secure AI adoption, including identity federation, privileged access, AI technologies.    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.    Proactively manage cross-domain dependencies, risks, issues and delivery constraints, escalating where required to maintain momentum and predictable execution.    Drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements, regulatory obligations and technology delivery roadmaps.    Ensure operational readiness, including service ownership, support models, resilience, security controls and transition to operations.    Provide senior stakeholders with concise, decision-oriented reporting on delivery status, financials, risks, dependencies and required actions.    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement. decisions.  Your background and skills include:     Proven track record in leading complex cross-functional technology programmes.    Strong experience coordinating initiatives spanning Identity & Access Management, Network, Security or enterprise governance functions.    Experience establishing governance frameworks, controls and operating models supporting adoption of emerging technologies.    Ability to manage complex dependency landscapes across infrastructure, security, architecture, risk and business stakeholders.    Experience driving delivery of foundational technology capabilities required by strategic programmes and platforms.    Strong understanding of security, regulatory and compliance considerations related to cloud and AI technologies.    Experience facilitating governance forums and steering committees involving senior business and technology leaders.    Ability to drive alignment between enterprise architecture, security requirements and technology delivery roadmaps.    Strong understanding of identity, privileged access, connectivity, segmentation, platform security and risk management principles.    Experience managing large-scale stakeholder ecosystems and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.    Very good financial and resource management skills.    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail.    Advanced presentation skills, especially PowerPoint and Excel.    Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.    Can-do attitude.It would be ideal if you also:     Have an interest in AI governance, AI platforms and emerging technology trends.    Have experience working in highly regulated environments.    Understand cloud platform operating models and enterprise security controls.    Can translate strategic objectives into executable delivery plans and measurable outcomes.If title: Senior Development Engineer
description: A snapshot of your day Become part of Siemens Energy, where your journey as a Senior Development Engineer begins! Imagine developing your technical skills while building both social and professional networks. You will take responsibility for the lubrication oil system and the technical solutions in assigned development projects, and work closely with project teams to ensure that the products meet specified requirements. Your role will be crucial for delivering development projects on time and within budget, while supporting cross-functional collaboration and mentoring junior team members. With opportunities for personal development and hands-on experience, you will be at the forefront of innovation in energy technology. How You Will Make an Impact* You will own the technical solutions in assigned development projects. * Collaborate closely with project teams and project managers to ensure that the products meet specified requirements in line with the technical roadmap. * Ensure delivery on time and within the agreed scope and budget, and communicate clearly with stakeholders on technical matters. * Support cross-functional collaboration to contribute to the Product Center of Competence. * Mentor and support junior colleagues through review and training, strengthening the team's capabilities.What You Bring* You have a solid base of experience to draw on, which gives you good intuition in your judgments. You are used to evaluation/correcting other engineers' solutions. * You have experience with fluid systems. * You hold a university or master's degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology or an equivalent education. * You have a good command of Swedish and English, both spoken and written. * You have a strong interest in working with mechanical systems and can help make working methods and processes more efficient. * You work carefully and methodically, with the ability to analyze and critically assess products and solutions. * You are collaborative, driven, have excellent problem-solving skills, and are responsible and flexible, with the patience to dig into technical details. About the TeamOur team consists of two technology areas with a total of 12 members. In the lubrication oil technology area, we currently have two experienced employees, one of whom is the technology area lead, as well as two newly graduated consultants and two consultants based in India. Together we are committed to developing innovative solutions that meet market demands and customer wishes, while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Application Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , ID nr 303647 not later than 2026-12-07. Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers. title: Sales Operations Specialist
description: Would you like to work for a growing company devoted to making a real difference in drug development through groundbreaking imaging? A place that is constantly moving forward, with great science, great people, and an informal atmosphere? Then keep reading.At Antaros Medical, we use advanced imaging methods such as MRI and PET to design and deliver clinical trials for decision-making and differentiation in drug development. We value competence and development as much as ideas and solutions. Relationships and trust are key to success, and we currently have around 160 employees across Sweden and the US.As part of our continued growth, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to join our commercial team in Sweden.Role overviewAs a Sales Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting our commercial operations and ensuring a seamless customer journey. Working closely with Business Development, Project Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, you will coordinate proposals, contracts, budgets, and commercial documentation while helping maintain efficient and scalable ways of working.  The position combines proposal development, pricing and budget preparation, contract administration, commercial operations support, and process improvement activities.You will be reporting to our Director Sales Operations, based in Uppsala. This role offers an opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of an international life science company while supporting partnerships with global pharmaceutical and biotech companies.Key responsibilitiesCommercial & Proposal Coordination    Prepare and coordinate proposals, budgets, and commercial documentation.    Support Business Development throughout the customer lifecycle.    Maintain and improve proposal templates, pricing tools, and supporting materials. Contract & Documentation Management    Support administration of contracts, change orders, and related commercial documentation.    Maintain document control, tracking, and compliance with internal processes. Sales Operations & Process Excellence    Support CRM administration, reporting, and commercial data management.    Help improve processes, increase efficiency, and drive operational excellence across functions.Who are we looking for?We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders. You are organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with strong communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with numbers, budgets, and complex Excel-based calculations, and you are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a growing organization where your contribution can make a real difference. Requirements    2-4 years of experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Proposal Management or similar    Experience from a clinical research organization (CRO), imaging services provider or another project-based service organization.    Experience with pricing, budgeting, and proposal development.    Experience managing and coordinating proposals, budgets, contracts, or other commercial documentation involving multiple stakeholders.    Experience working with commercial agreements such as MSAs, SOWs, Change Orders, or similar contracts.    Bachelor's degree in business administration, Life Sciences, Project Management, or related field.    Strong Excel skills, including working with complex calculations and data, as well as proficiency in Microsoft 365.    Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Advantageous    Experience within Life Science, biotech, pharmaceutical, or healthcare environments.    Experience with medical imaging or imaging-based clinical research.    Experience supporting global customers and international commercial teams.    Experience driving process improvements and implementing new ways of working.    Experience working with CPQ (configure/price/quote) and Sales CRM systems Are you interested?If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application, including your CV, via the link below. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions about the role, please contact Malin Hagström, HR Business Partner, at malin.hagstrom@antarosmedical.com.This is a permanent full-time position with a six-month probationary period. Applications are handled exclusively through Teamtailor. The recruitment process is managed directly by Antaros Medical, and we kindly ask recruitment and staffing agencies not to contact us regarding this position. About Antaros MedicalAt Antaros Medical, we combine ground-breaking imaging with profound experience in drug development and deep knowledge of disease mechanisms. We are specialized in cardiorenal & metabolic diseases and oncology. We have a global network of collaboration partners and customers, including both Big Pharma and Biotechs, and several European collaboration initiatives such as Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI) and COST.Antaros Medical has delivered small complex, mechanistic studies as well as multi-center clinical trials worldwide utilizing our innovative imaging methods. title: Domain Architect Finance & Supply Chain
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Domain Architect Finance &amp; Supply Chain--- Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain========================================vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haley and Dr. Goly Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders. At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. Our portfolio includes oral health products for dental professionals, patients, and consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, grounded in our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations in Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey. **Purpose:**As Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain, you will own the design and governance of our ERP landscape across Finance and Supply Chain. You will translate business needs into scalable, compliant solutions, challenge designs where needed, and ensure changes meet both operational and regulatory requirements. Working across Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA, IT and external partners, you will help build an ERP environment that is reliable, controlled and ready to scale with vVARDIS.**Key responsibilities*** Own the ERP requirements. Turn what Finance and Supply Chain ask for into clear, prioritized requirements with acceptance criteria, and say no when a request would break a control or the design.* Act as the design authority. Every change from a partner, developer or internal team passes your review before it goes live.* Get Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA (Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs) and IT to agree on one target design and roadmap.* Steer our implementation partners: scope, estimates, change requests and delivery quality. Accept work against criteria, not against effort spent.* Own SOX (Sarbanes\-Oxley) IT general controls in the ERP: change management, segregation of duties in security roles, and key reports finance can rely on.* Keep GxP\-relevant ( Practice regulations) processes validated. Take a risk\-based approach under GAMP 5 ( Automated Manufacturing Practice) with records that meet EU GMP ( Manufacturing Practice) Annex 11 and FDA 21 CFR Part 11\.* Make sure Microsoft’s mandatory service updates go through regression testing without weeks of manual revalidation.**Required Qualifications \& Experience*** You have led D365 Finance and Supply Chain, or a comparable ERP, as an architect, solution lead or lead consultant, and have defended at least one SOX or GxP audit.* You know Finance and Supply Chain processes well enough to challenge a partner’s design, from purchase to payment and from receiving goods to the close.* You can spot a change that runs without errors but posts to the wrong ledger account or bypasses an approval.* You write requirements a partner can’t misread, and acceptance criteria they can’t argue with.* You can hand an inspector the validation evidence for any change in minutes, because the process produced it, not because someone assembled it for the audit.* You use AI tools in your daily work, for example to analyse requirements, review configuration or draft test cases, and know where they need a human check.* You can tell a partner their estimate is wrong without starting a war.* You work fluently in English.**Key Competencies / Soft Skills*** Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, processes and deadlines while maintaining alignment with other dependencies on priorities and expected deliverables* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation and record\-keeping, with ownership of the accuracy and completeness of work* Clear and concise written and verbal communication, with strong listening skills and the ability to clarify requirements and expectations before proceeding* Openness to feedback, with the ability to translate it into practical improvements and adapt working methods when needed* A diplomatic and collaborative approach to cross\-functional work, with the ability to influence without direct authority and follow up effectively with process owners* Proactive and able to work independently, while recognizing when to seek guidance, flag risks, or escalate issues* Sound judgment and a constructive approach to problem\-solving, with the ability to consider different perspectives, raise concerns, and follow through on agreed decisions and actions* An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable insights* Adaptability to changing priorities and business or regulatory requirements, while maintaining quality and a continuous improvement mindset**Your Personality*** You like order. A vague requirement or a change without test evidence bothers you until it’s fixed.* You own outcomes, not tasks. When a partner delivers the wrong thing, you fix the process that let it happen, not just the ticket.* You’re structured without being bureaucratic. A control has to protect something real, or you argue to remove it.* You hold your position with a partner, the CFO or QA when the evidence supports you, and you change it when it doesn’t.* You learn fast and enjoy it, whether it’s a new regulation, a Microsoft release or a process you’ve never seen.* You know your work ends up in a product patients use and in numbers the auditors sign. That’s why you do it right, not why you’re nervous about it.**Apply**No cover letter. Send one page about an ERP change you steered from request to go\-live. Tell us how you defined and accepted it, which control or validation step you built in, and how you handled a change or design that presented a compliance or audit risk.![vVARDIS AG]()* vVARDIS AG  Gubelstrasse 24  6300 Zug*jidc6017f9jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

Anschliessend prüfst und dokumentierst du die Umsetzung.* Bei Störungen grenzt du mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen die Ursache ein. Du hältst den Kunden auf dem Laufenden und dokumentierst die Lösung für das Team.### Das bringst du mit* Eine Informatikausbildung oder vergleichbare Praxis sowie mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der technischen Betreuung von KMU\-Kunden.* Du hast fundierte Praxiserfahrung mit Windows Server, Active Directory, Gruppenrichtlinien und RDS. Für Kundeneinsätze sind ein Führerausweis der Kategorie B und ein eigenes Auto zwingend.### Von Vorteil* Praktische Erfahrung mit Proxmox VE, OPNsense oder pfSense. Erfahrung mit Linux, weiteren Open\-Source\-Lösungen oder der Automatisierung mit PowerShell oder Ansible ist ebenfalls willkommen.### Das bieten wir dir* Du hast kurze Entscheidungswege und kannst dich bei der einer passenden Lösung direkt mit unseren Technikern und Entwicklern austauschen.* Wir betreiben eigene Rechenzentren. description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Senior Patent Counsel--- Senior Patent Counsel=====================SICPA sets *the pulse of sovereignty*, enabling governments to protect their citizens, sovereign assets, and economies. Best known for securing the majority of the world’s banknotes, SICPA operates across five continents. Today, our platform for sovereignty delivers integrated solutions safeguarding revenue mobilisation, natural resources, health, and brand protection as well as digital sovereignty and secure public services.The primary objective of this role is to ensure that technology identification, extraction and protection are aligned with the business activities in the field of chemistry. A strong understanding of the underlying technologies and their commercial applications is therefore essential to success in this position. The in\-house Patent Attorney will act as a hands\-on partner to the business, advising on day\-to\-day business development opportunities and ensuring that new innovations are effectively identified and protected through patents. Working closely with the Research \& Innovation (R\&I) team and the IP department, the role will focus on innovation extraction, patent drafting and prosecution. The role requires a proactive, collaborative approach, working across R\&I, Commercial and Legal teams to ensure that intellectual property protection supports the company's broader business objectives. The ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise messages and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels is essential. **Key responsibilities*** Work closely with the Research \& Innovation team, harvest and capture innovation. Pro\-actively look for inventions and create and maintain awareness about use and necessity of patent applications.* Contribute to the acquisition, protection, defence and enforcement (drafting, filing, prosecution, opposition, appeal, etc.) of patent rights; prosecution of a global patent portfolio in the assigned technical areas.* Provide comprehensive patent support to selected projects as an integral member of multidisciplinary project teams.* Formulate strategic practice recommendations in response to commercial, legal and technical developments, this includes evaluating patent validity, patent risk management and infringement issues and reviewing IP\-related agreements.**Essential duties*** Analysis of the innovation and potential inventions, drafting, filing of patent applications and worldwide prosecution; therefore, drafting skills are essential here and prosecution, opposition and infringement matters offer a wide variety of work.* Liaise prior art search reports from external providers and assess feasibility and patentability.* Draft IP related aspects of agreements with third\-party collaborators and service providers.* Oversee patent risk management and provide Freedom to Operate opinion and clearance studies.* Working closely with R\&I division, sales and legal and promote patent culture with good visibility within the company. The direct contact with international colleagues and clients will require commitment, passion, strong communication skills and commercial savviness. **Profile*** PhD (preferred) or master’s degree in chemistry.* Be passionate about the technology you work with and follow the developments within the industry with invested interest.* Qualified European Patent Attorney. Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in drafting and prosecuting patent cases after EPA qualification.* Proactive, structured with a collaborative working style with solid team player attributes with the ability to manage relationships with different stakeholders in the company.* Possess strong communication and interpersonal skills to work with cross\-functional teams across departments and divisions.* Show flexibility under stress and delivers quality work with strong attention to detail in an autonomous manner.* Fluent in English, French a strong asset is a plus ![SICPA SA]()* SICPA SA  Avenue de Florissant 41  1008 Prilly*jid0dae7d0jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %
description: Curious about the roles of households in the new Swiss Local Electricity Community regulation and how they evolve at the interface of politics and the energy sector? Then you've come to the right place! PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 % \*\*What you will be responsible for\*\* Since January 2026, so\\-called Local Electricity Communities (LEG) enable Swiss households to buy and sell PV electricity within their neighbourhood. Whether LEGs will become established and make a substantial contribution to Switzerland's energy targets remains to be seen in the coming years. This is being investigated by the SFOE\\-funded research project "LEAP" lead by the ZHAW in partnership with the University of Lausanne and Swisspower AG. The PhD position advertised focuses on the evolving roles, expectations and experiences of the key stakeholders in the LEGs (households, LEG service providers and energy suppliers), with a particular focus on the households who join an LEG. \* Work towards a PhD (co\\-supervised by the University of Lausanne) within the LEAP project \* Plan and carry out surveys and interviews for your data collection \* Analyse and present findings in the form of academic publications \* Collaborate with the project team and beyond ( , communicating with partners, presenting research results at scientific conferences, etc.) \* Provide ad hoc support to the Institute of Innovation \\\& Entrepreneurship in teaching ( supervising student projects) or other research projects \*\*What makes you a great fit\*\* \* You hold a an excellent Master's degree in Management, Environmental Sciences, Social Sciences, or similarly fitting field ( , renewable energy). \* In addition to fluency in German and/or French (a requirement for data collection), you have an excellent command of written and spoken English. \* You have solid knowledge in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods ( designing and analysing surveys or semi\\-structured interviews). \* You have a strong interest to do societally and scientifically relevant work. \* You enjoy independence and autonomy, and can take responsibility for your own PhD thesis, as well as for the related project objectives. Nonetheless, you know the value of collaboration and are keen to contribute to the exchange of ideas and results with the project's research and practice partners. \* Your have a clear and open communication style, and bring curiosity and enthusiasm to the team. \* Practical experience in interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary project settings, as well as in the field of energy (particularly regarding energy communities), would be a welcome addition to your profile. \*\*About your workplace\*\* The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in German\\-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees. We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances. \*\*School of Management and Law\*\* The ZHAW School of Management and Law (SML) is one of the largest business schools in Switzerland with around 9,500 students. It is the only university of applied sciences in the country that is included in renowned rankings published by the business newspaper "Financial Times" and is accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA \\- labels for high quality standards in teaching, research and further education. The internationally recognized bachelor's and master's degree programs, cooperative PhD programs and the numerous continuing education offerings are scientifically sound, interdisciplinary and practice oriented. The SML maintains numerous collaborations with over 190 selected partner universities worldwide. \*\*\[ZHAW Institute for Innovation and Entrepreneurship\](\< \>)\*\* The Institute conducts research, teaches and provides consultancy in the key areas of business innovation, innovation systems and entrepreneurship. One of our key areas of focus is the transformation of the energy system, in close collaboration with various stakeholders at the interface of research, politics and society. \*\*Any questions?
